Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Software Development & Digital Products ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van ons softwareontwikkelingsteam en het beheren van onze digitale producten die door het combineren van verschillende datastromen actiegerichte informatie leveren aan onze klanten . Je speelt een cruciale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van innovatieve softwareoplossingen die bijdragen aan de efficiëntie en betrouwbaarheid van onze spooranalyses en -metingen.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Leiding geven aan het softwareontwikkelingsteam en zorgen voor een inspirerende en productieve werkomgeving.
Optimaliseren van werkprocessen en het implementeren van best practices om de efficiëntie en kwaliteit van het werk te verhogen.
Ontwikkelen en implementeren van digitale strategieën en productroadmaps.
Samenwerken met interne en externe stakeholders om de behoeften en eisen van klanten te begrijpen en te vertalen naar technische oplossingen.
Toezicht houden op de volledige levenscyclus van softwareontwikkeling, van concept tot implementatie en onderhoud.
Zorgen voor de naleving van kwaliteitsnormen en best practices in softwareontwikkeling.
Identificeren en implementeren van nieuwe technologieën en tools om de efficiëntie en prestaties van onze digitale producten te verbeteren.

Wat wij bieden

Als Great Place to Work-gecertificeerde organisatie weten we wat belangrijk is voor onze mensen. De betrokkenheid en trots binnen de organisatie zijn groot. Je krijgt veel ruimte om eigenaarschap te nemen en vanuit jouw expertise bij te dragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Dat betekent: vrijheid, vertrouwen en volop ruimte voor initiatief.
We vinden jouw ontwikkeling belangrijk en ondersteunen dit actief met opleidingsmogelijkheden en doorgroeikansen. Daarnaast is veiligheid een kernwaarde binnen onze organisatie; we besteden hier continu aandacht aan, zodat iedereen zijn werk met vertrouwen en een goed gevoel kan uitvoeren.

Daarnaast krijg je;

Een bruto periodesalaris tussen €5.400,= en €7.600,= per 4 weken op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur), waarbij jouw kennis en ervaring bepalend zijn voor de inschaling.

25 vakantiedagen + 13 extra vrije dagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) voor een goede werk-privébalans.

Volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een persoonlijk studie- en opleidingsbudget.

Een hybride werkomgeving met de mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, passend bij de rol en de behoeften van het team.

Een informele en professionele organisatie met korte lijnen, betrokken collega's en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Extra keuzemogelijkheden via de CAO à la carte-regeling.

Wat breng je mee?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-bacheloropleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
Ruime ervaring in softwareontwikkeling en digitale productmanagement, bij voorkeur in een leidinggevende rol.
Kennis van programmeertalen zoals Java, Python, en C++ is een pré.
Ervaring met agile ontwikkelingsmethodologieën en projectmanagementtools.
Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.
Uitstekende communicatie- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden.
Je beheerst het Nederlands en/of Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

Bestehende Ansätze hinterfragen und neue Wege finden. Das machst du nicht alleine, sondern mit einem neu entstehenden Team. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle
sind bei uns selbstverständlich – du kannst gerne von zu Hause arbeiten und gleichzeitig freuen wir uns, dich an unseren Teamtagen (Di. und Do.) im Büro in Freiburg im Breisgau
begrüßen zu dürfen.

Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Du hast die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten. Tech-Stack & Architektur: Du arbeitest in einer modernen Microservice-Architektur und stellst die reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen den Services sicher. Mit deinem Team entscheidest du über den Einsatz neuer Tools und Ansätze, die es braucht, damit Skalierung tatsächlich möglich wird.
Agentic AI & Future Work: Wir begreifen KI nicht nur als Werkzeug, sondern als Motor für einen fundamentalen Wachstumsschritt. Full Stack@Heart: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bau moderner Backend-Systeme mit Spring Boot und Java. Erfahrung mit React, TypeScript und Material UI runden dein breit aufgebautes Profil ab

Kommunikation: Unsere Teamsprache ist Deutsch, daher sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C2) ein Muss

jobs.title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
 Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 What Success Looks Like: Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

Be  Ambitious
 to succeed    
Be  Imaginative
 to push the boundaries of what’s possible    
Be  Inspirational
 to do groundbreaking work    
Be  always learning and listening
to understand    
Be  Results-focused 

to exceed expectations    
Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist
across our community, clients and creations

All applicants shall be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodivergence, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Wir bei DXC Technology suchen eine:n Java Software Engineer
mit architektonischem Verständnis.

In dieser Rolle entwickeln Sie gemeinsam mit unseren Teams individuelle Softwarelösungen für Kundenprojekte – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Entwicklern sowie den Architekten unserer Kunden zusammen, um nachhaltige Software-Architekturen zu gestalten. Die Position kann hybrid ausgeübt werden. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich
, da die Projekte national und international stattfinden.

Standort: Erfurt

Ihre Aufgaben

Als Software-Entwickler und -Architekt ergeben sich für Sie folgende Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte:

Sie setzen Anforderungen in Programmcode um und verwenden dabei bestehende sowie neue Frameworks.
Aus Ihrem Verständnis für individuelle Software-Architekturen unserer Kunden leiten Sie technische Umsetzungsvorschläge ab.
Sie strukturieren Umsetzungsprojekte in Arbeitspakete für unsere Entwickler-Teams.
Sie stimmen Umsetzungen mit Architekten unserer Kunden ab.
Sie dokumentieren Umsetzungen in Code-Kommentaren, Umsetzungsvorschlägen und Spezifikationen in deutscher und englischer Sprache, abhängig vom Projektumfeld.

Folgende Fähigkeiten Und Erfahrungen Sollten Sie Mitbringen

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Java-Entwickler, auch in agilen Projektumfeldern
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, JUnit, Git, relationalen Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL, MariaDB oder Oracle DB, Web-Technologien
Umsetzungserfahrungen in Architekturen und Frameworks wie JEE, Hibernate, JSF, Primefaces, React, Angular, JavaFX
Erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Software-Architektur
Hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil, Aber Nicht Zwingend Erforderlich

Kenntnisse in kryptografischen Verfahren sowie Implementierungen von Benutzer-Authentifizierung und -Autorisierung, MFA, eID (z. B. Keycloak, EIDAS, LDAP)
Erfahrung mit DevOps-Ansätzen inkl. Tools wie Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, SonarQube
Kenntnisse zu APIs inkl. automatisierter Tests ggf. unter Verwendung selbst erstellter Mockups/Simulatoren
Erfahrungen in Datenmigrationsprojekten
Kenntnisse weiterer Programmiersprachen
Erstellung automatisierter Testfälle mit Tools wie Selenium, Jira XRay
Erfahrungen mit Infrastructure as Code und Cloudplattformen von Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder Google
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Behörden im öffentlichen Sektor
Relevante Zertifizierungen im Java-Umfeld (OCPJ), ISAQB, TOGAF, V-Modell XT, Scrum Master oder Zertifizierungen der Hyperscaler Cloud-Anbieter.

Darüber Hinaus Sollten Sie Mitbringen

Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung nach abgeschlossener IHK-Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Bereitschaft zu internen und externen Weiterbildungen
Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisetätigkeiten im In- und Ausland

Was Wir Ihnen Bieten

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
Attraktives Vergütungspaket
Trainings- und Mentoring-Programme zur Unterstützung Ihrer Karriere
Möglichkeit, mit modernsten Technologien in hochentwickelten Enterprise-Umgebungen zu arbeiten und Services für internationale Kunden bereitzustellen
Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte bei einem der weltweit größten IT-Dienstleister – kombiniert mit schnellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und spannenden Aufgaben bei hohem Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Bei DXC sind es die einzigartigen Beiträge unserer Mitarbeitenden, die uns erfolgreich machen. Jede Idee und jede Person zählt. Unsere inklusive Unternehmenskultur stärkt unsere Leistung – und unser Unternehmen wächst nur, wenn unsere Mitarbeitenden wachsen.

Wir stehen für Gleichberechtigung. Als globaler Technologieführer unterstützen wir vielfältige Kundinnen und nehmen eine Vorreiterrolle in den Gemeinschaften ein, in denen wir tätig sind. DXC engagiert sich für Vielfalt sowie faire und inklusive Auswahlverfahren. Qualifizierte Bewerberinnen erhalten bei uns die gleichen Chancen auf eine Anstellung.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie mit uns die digitale Transformation!

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. jobs.description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Mache den nächsten Schritt in deiner beruflichen Laufbahn oder starte deine Karriere nach deinem kaufmännischen oder technischen Abschluss mit abwechslungsreichen Themen rund um die Business Resilienz und Risikominimierung unserer Kunden. Unser Business & Technology Center
übernimmt unterschiedliche Aufgaben, darunter die Implementierung und das Management von risikobezogenen Prozessen, Tools und Dokumentationen bei namhaften Kunden. Wir arbeiten an aktuellen Themen wie Cyberattacken, Compliance, Datenschutz, Identity Management, Vertragsmanagement, Nachhaltigkeit und Projektrisiken. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Software Tester / Testautomatisierer (m/w/d)
.

Standorte: Leipzig
und Frankfurt (Main)
.

Dein Impact:

Als Software Tester / Testautomatisierer (m/w/d) bringst du dein vorhandenes Wissen im Bereich Secure Software Testing gewinnbringend in vielseitige und abwechslungsreiche Projekte ein.

Programmierkenntnisse: Du verstehst einfache und auch komplexe Programme und weißt, wie sich bestimmte Funktionen auswirken
Erfahrung: Dein Know-how mit Analysetools führt zu einer Verkürzung von Entwicklungsprozessen und steigert die Qualität der Software
Methodenvielfalt: Ob klassisch oder agil - unterschiedliche Methoden und Herangehensweisen sind dir bekannt und du weißt, wie du dein Know-how gewinnbringend einsetzen kannst.
Mitwirkung: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team erstellst du automatisierte Test Cases und entwickelst diese weiter
Dokumentation: In deinen Projekten dokumentierst du die Testergebnisse und bereitest sie für die für die Projektleitung auf

Dein Skillset:

Als Software Tester (Testmanager) bringst Du mit:
Erfahrung in Software-Testing im Rahmen von Agile- und Scrum-Methoden, idealerweise eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung
Erfahrung mit Testmanagement Tools z. B. (Jira, Xray. Confluence , Microfocus ALM, Zephyr, Azure DevOps)
Als Testautomatisierer (Automation Engineer) hast Du
Erfahrung in Software-Automatisierungstests von Webanwendungen und/oder Backend-Anwendungen und/oder ETL Testing.
Erfahrung in mindestens einer der genannten Lösungen: Selenium, Cucumber, Ranorex, Tosca, Eggplant, UFT - Unified Functional Testing, Octane, Soap UI, PostMan, Protractor (Angular), Appium, Espresso.
Spaß an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen und aufwachsenden Team
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise fließend Englisch.

Deine Chance:

Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperation mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Noch Fragen?
Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs
.

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

jobs.description:
Job description

mobile.de is Germany’s largest vehicle marketplace, with more than 1.6 million listed cars, commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and e-bikes (annual average 2025). Both private customers and registered vehicle dealers use the platform and benefit from more than 140 million visits per month*. As a “one-stop shop,” mobile.de’s offering includes not only buying and selling, but also financing and leasing solutions. Based in Berlin-Charlottenburg, we offer a dynamic environment where growth, learning, and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. Collaborate with senior team members to provide technical support on system capabilities, configurations, and best practices to internal teams and stakeholders
Participate in reviewing technical implementations, code, and customizations with guidance from senior engineers

Learn from and collaborate with team members on technical aspects of Microsoft Dynamics, contributing to a culture of continuous learning

Job responsibilities

3+ years of hands-on expertise in Microsoft Dynamics NAV and/or Business Central, including hands-on experience with customizations, extensions, and integrations.
Proficient knowledge of AL programming language and Business Central development tools

jobs.title: IT Experts - Application Development Engineers and Digital Workplace Architect - DGIS
Senior Data Integration Specialist (m/w/d) - Smart Grid Software  | 100 % Remote DE/AT
jobs.description:
Als Elektrotechniker:in, Informatiker:in oder Data Integration Engineer verbindest du unterschiedliche Netzdaten, Systeme und Schnittstellen und schaffst damit den digitalen Zwilling eines Stromnetzes in unserer Smart-Grid-Plattform – 100 % remote und mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

Dabei leistest du mit deiner Arbeit einen echten Beitrag zur Energiewende. 

Die Zukunft in Echtzeit — das sind WIR:

Als inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main entwickeln wir seit 2012 Softwarelösungen für die Herausforderungen von morgen und wachsen stetig. Unsere Stärke ist es, Energienetze im Nieder- und Mittelspannungsbereich zu digitalisieren, in Echtzeit zu überwachen und vorausschauend zu steuern. Unsere Software setzt also dort an, wo klassische SCADA-Systeme aufgrund der enormen Datenmengen in zukünftigen Smart Grids allein nicht mehr wirksam sein können.
VENIOS ist echt, bahnbrechend und verantwortungsvoll. VENIOS schafft Mehrwerte für Mitarbeitende, Kunden und die Gesellschaft.

DEINE Aufgaben bei uns:

Du bist Teil eines aktuell noch vierköpfigen Teams
Du baust für unsere Kunden den digitalen Zwilling ihres Stromnetzes in Venios.Net auf: Du konzipierst und verantwortest die fachliche und technische Architektur
Du integrierst unterschiedliche Datenquellen und Systeme (z. B. GIS, SCADA, Messsysteme, Asset-Daten, Wetter- und Prognosedaten) zu einem konsistenten Gesamtmodell
Du validierst die gelieferten Daten 

Du arbeitest eng mit Projektleitung, Produktmanagement, Entwicklung, DevOps und Kunden zusammen und agierst als technische:r Sparringspartner:in
Du bist ein wichtiger Teil des Implementierungsteams bei Pilotierungen und Rollouts

DEINE Skills:

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes MINT-Studium, bevorzugt in der Informatik, Geoinformatik, E-Technik oder Physik
Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Programmierung, vorzugsweise in Hochsprachen wie C#
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Datenintegrator, Systemintegrator oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Datenmodellen, Integrationsarchitekturen und APIs mit
Du bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse im Energiewirtschafts- oder Smart-Grid-Umfeld (z. B. Verteilnetze, Netzmodelle, Netzbetrieb) mit
Du weißt bestenfalls wie ein Stromnetz aufgebaut ist und kennst dich mit Geoinformationssystemen aus
Du besitzt Kommunikationsstärke und Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – intern wie extern
Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von IT-Architekturen, verteilten Systemen, Cloud-Plattformen und Datenarchitekturen
Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch und kommunizierst klar und überzeugend
Du hast einen Wohnort bzw. eine Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland oder in Österreich

Für UNS selbstverständlich:

Du bist uns wichtig und wir schenken Dir vom ersten Tag an volles Vertrauen
Wir arbeiten Dich gezielt ein und sind jederzeit auf Augenhöhe an Deiner Seite
Wir interessieren uns für Dich und Deine Ideen
Wir arbeiten remote und ermöglichen Dir in deinem Rhythmus zu arbeiten
Wir möchten langfristig und unbefristet mit Dir zusammenarbeiten
Wir zahlen abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung ein Jahresgehalt z.B. als Senior ab 70.000 EUR und bis 75.000 EUR
Wir geben Dir 28 Tage Urlaub zzgl. Weihnachten und Silvester
Wir halten Dich mobil (Deutschlandticket, Job- oder Business-Bike)
Wir halten Dich fit und unterstützen Dich mit einem EGYM-Wellpass
Wir entlasten Dich durch Kostenübernahme der Kinderbetreuung
Wir sehen uns regelmäßig zu Sommerfesten, Weihnachtsfeiern, zu Workshops auch mal außerhalb vom Homeoffice

Hast Du Lust, Teil von VENIOS zu werden?

Unser Team und die Aufgaben sind genau das, was du willst und wo du dich wohl fühlen würdest? Dann melde Dich unbedingt bei uns und zeig uns, wer Du bist.
Bewirb dich direkt in wenigen Minuten über unser Karriereportal.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect (all genders)
jobs.description:
Als AI Solution Architect gestaltest du innovative ML-/AI-Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Produktion. Du baust moderne MLOps-Pipelines, optimierst Modelle für Performance und Skalierbarkeit und stellst Compliance sowie Security sicher. Gemeinsam mit Data Scientists, Engineers und Stakeholdern treibst du AI-Innovationen voran und unterstützt das Team durch Coaching und Mentoring.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Konzeption, Entwicklung und Skalierung von Enterprise AI-/ML-Lösungen
Aufbau und Optimierung von MLOps-Pipelines (CI/CD, Deployment, Monitoring, Retraining)
Performance-Optimierung und Orchestrierung von Modellen in produktiven Umgebungen
Sicherstellung von Robustheit, Fairness, Compliance und Security in AI-Anwendungen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientists & Engineers bei Datenpipelines, Feature Stores und Modellvalidierung
Auswahl und Integration moderner Tools, Frameworks und Architekturen
Mitgestaltung von Standards, Best Practices und strategischer Roadmap im Bereich AI/ML
Coaching und Mentoring von Junior- und Mid-Level-Engineers

Qualifikationen

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Architektur, Implementierung und Betrieb von AI-/ML-Lösungen
Fundierte Kenntnisse in GenAI, LLMs, MLMs und RAG (Architektur, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning, Agent-Orchestrierung)
Erfahrung mit gängigen Frameworks wie LangChain, LangGraph oder Haystack
Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie Praxis mit CI/CD-Pipelines
Know-how in Cloud-Umgebungen (z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks), Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform)
Vertrautheit mit MLOps (MLflow, Deployment, Observability, Governance)
Kenntnisse in Compliance & Security (z. B. DSGVO, ISO/IEC 27001/27701, TISAX)
Erfahrung in der Konzeption digitaler Lösungen und in der Präsentation vor Kunde

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Gewünschte Fähigkeiten

Kenntnisse in Software-Engineering (Clean Code, Design Patterns, Testing)
Erfahrung in Projekt- oder Team-Management (Scrum, CRISP-DM)
Praxis mit lokalen LLMs (Llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, Unsloth) und gängigen ML-Bibliotheken (PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV)
Erfahrung im Aufbau von AI-Plattformen (Enterprise Search, Testautomatisierung, Coding Agents)
Know-how in Datenanalyse (Statistik, Tableau, R)
Zertifizierungen in AI, ML, Cloud oder Software-Engineering

Leistungen

Bei Expleo setzen wir auf Teamwork, Offenheit, Transparenz und Wertschätzung. Wir gehen unsere Aufgaben gemeinsam an
Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team
Bei uns sind alle gleich und wir tragen alle die gleiche Farbe: LILA!
Wir bieten dir Gleitzeit, ein ausführliches Onboarding, Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und unzählige Mitarbeiter-Benefits. Wir bieten einen Arbeitsplatz, der deine persönlichen Lebensumstände berücksichtigt und dich absichert
Man lernt nie aus: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns sehr am Herzen. Wir bieten interne Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unterstützen dich und deine perspektivischen Ziele
Wir haben Lust etwas zu bewegen, uns gegenseitig zu motivieren und freuen uns, wenn auch du deinen Teil zum großen Ganzen beitragen: Deine Erfahrung, deine Ideen und dein Engagement finden bei uns Gehör und werden honoriert
Unsere Kunden können sich nicht nur sehen lassen; sie gehören zu den Top-Playern ihrer Branchen, in den Bereichen Banken und Versicherungen, Automotive, Luftfahrt, Transport, Life Science und viele mehr
Das soziale Miteinander ist uns wichtig. Wir setzen auf Teambuilding und Identifikation

Du willst mehr über uns wissen? Besuche einfach unseren Youtube-Kanal und schau Dir unsere Videos an. Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen.

Job description:

Contract type: Permanent

Location: Edinburgh

Working style: Hybrid 50% home/office based

Closing date: 18th September 2026

Job Summary
Royal London is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join one of our application delivery teams within the Digital space at Royal London.
This role is focused on modern software and application engineering: designing, building and operating customer-facing and internal digital services with a strong emphasis on Azure-based application development using Angular and C#/.NET.
You will be a senior member of a cross-functional squad, contributing to solution design and delivery while remaining hands-on. You will build high-quality, secure and resilient applications, support engineering best practice, and help develop less experienced engineers through mentoring and collaboration.
This is an application-focused role, working closely with product, architecture, cloud and mobile teams to deliver valuable outcomes for customers and colleagues.

About the role  
Design, build, test and operate Angular front-end and C#/.NET back-end services deployed in Azure.
Contribute to technical design and impact assessments for changes to new and existing applications.
Produce and maintain technical documentation to the required standards.
Apply engineering best practices, including clean code, automated testing and observability.
Work closely with Architects, Testers, Product Owners, Analysts and stakeholders to deliver high-quality outcomes.
Support the day-to-day operation of live applications, including incident investigation, troubleshooting and resolution.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, helping to maintain engineering standards across the squad.
Mentor and support other engineers, contributing to a positive and collaborative engineering culture.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of software engineering practices within the wider Digital engineering community.

About you  
You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys designing and building well-engineered applications. You care deeply about software quality, security, resilience and operability, and you take pride in delivering maintainable solutions.
You are comfortable balancing:
Technical design and software development.
Delivery of high-quality outcomes.
Problem solving and continuous improvement.
Supporting and mentoring engineers within the team.

You thrive in a collaborative, product-focused environment where engineering judgement matters.

Essential Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with experience delivering solutions across the full application development lifecycle.
Proven experience designing, building and maintaining modern web applications with strong expertise in either Angular (or similar front-end frameworks) or C#/.NET, and working knowledge of the complementary stack.
Strong experience building and running applications in Azure cloud environments, with an emphasis on application-level design, resilience and security.
Strong understanding of API-driven and service-based architecture.
Experience using CI/CD pipelines to build, test and deploy application code safely and repeatedly.
Strong focus on application quality including testing, performance, security, resilience and operational readiness.
Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions within an established architectural framework.
Experience supporting and mentoring engineers at different career stages.
A mindset of continuous improvement, actively developing your own skills and contributing to engineering best practice.

Nice to Have

Experience with common Azure services used in application delivery, such as App Services, Functions, Storage, Key Vault and Application Insights.
Experience with API Management (e.g. Azure APIM) as part of application integration.
Exposure to mobile application development (iOS, Android and/or cross-platform frameworks) or experience supporting mobile apps via backend services.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep or Terraform).
Experience building and supporting applications in regulated or security-conscious environments.

About Royal London  
We’re the UK’s largest mutual life, pensions and investment company, offering protection, long-term savings and asset management products and services.   

Our People Promise to our colleagues is that we will all work somewhere inclusive, responsible, enjoyable and fulfilling. This is underpinned by our Spirit of Royal London values; Empowered, Trustworthy, Collaborate, Achieve. 

We've always been proud to reward employees by offering great workplace benefits such as 28 days annual leave in addition to bank holidays, an up to 14% employer matching pension scheme and private medical insurance.

Inclusion, diversity and belonging  
We’re an inclusive employer. We celebrate and value different backgrounds and cultures across Royal London. Our diverse people and perspectives give us a range of skills which are recognised and respected – whatever their background.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across the whole stack and is equally comfortable building conventional services and AI-enabled features. You will work alongside architects, product stakeholders and delivery partners to ship software that brokers and analysts use every day.

Key Responsibilities

Build Across the Stack: Design, build and ship features end to end, from APIs and services through to responsive, accessible user interfaces.
Cloud Native Delivery: Develop and run cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, using PaaS services, containers and infrastructure-as-code.

AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or Claude Cowork as part of your day-to-day workflow, and help the wider team adopt them well.
Integration: Integrate with external market platforms, carrier and client systems, and vendor SaaS products using API-first and event-driven patterns.
Quality & Security: Practise test-driven development and write secure, maintainable code, applying established security patterns including authentication and authorisation (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0), data protection and privacy from the start.
Collaboration: Build to the agreed architectural standards and help shape them, contributing to design discussions, reviewing code from in-house and partner engineers, and mentoring others across a greenfield estate.

About You

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys a fast-moving, greenfield environment and wants to work across both traditional and AI-native development. Ideally you will bring:

Experience: Extensive experience of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production systems end to end. Experience in insurance, reinsurance or wider financial services is a plus, but not essential.
Backend: Strong programming skills in C#/.NET or Python, with solid API design and strong SQL.
Frontend: Practical experience building modern user interfaces with React or Angular and TypeScript.
Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Standards & Security: Experience building to architectural standards and applying common patterns such as microservices, event-driven and API-led design, together with a strong grounding in security patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, Entra ID, RBAC) and secure coding practices.
Data: Comfortable working with relational databases and data-heavy application features, with strong SQL and an eye for query performance.
AI Development: Experience building with LLMs and AI-enabled solutions, or a clear appetite to learn. Familiarity with agentic patterns, prompt design and evaluation is a significant advantage.
Engineering Craft: Fluency in test-driven development and automated testing, an eye for maintainable design, and good judgement about when to keep things simple.
Communication: Ability to work closely with product stakeholders and delivery partners, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly.

We combine specialist broking with analytics, modeling and research to help insurers optimize risk transfer, strengthen balance sheets and achieve sustainable growth. Our approach is relationship-driven, transparent and outcome-focused.

At the heart of Willis Re is a focus on delivering the most cutting-edge analytical solutions to enable more informed, better decision-making for risk selection, portfolio optimization, and capital management.

The launch of Willis Re brings a strategic advantage of being unhindered by legacy, an ability to leverage data, statistical models and advanced technologies with the best knowledge and expertise to deliver more efficient and effective reinsurance outcomes. This places Willis Re in a unique position to build a truly analytically driven business, focused on creating solutions for the reinsurance industry that are future led and forward thinking.

Willis Re will also leverage recognized technical expertise from WTW’s Insurance Consulting & Technology business including their advanced modeling and analytical capabilities. Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA Instruments™ is our instrumentation division, which designs advanced metrology and inspection instruments used in both R&D and production across industries and academia. Our tools—ranging from optical profilers and nano-indenters to thin film and defect inspection systems—enable precise surface and material analysis. Oxfordshire | Hybrid | Up to £100k + Bonus

Designing and building reliable backend services and APIs.
Working primarily with Java
as the main backend language.

Working with distributed and event-driven architectures.
Investigating performance issues and identifying bottlenecks.
Thinking through architecture, system design and technical trade-offs.
Improving monitoring, observability and operational reliability.
Writing well-tested, maintainable production code.
Working across the stack when needed, including modern frontend technologies.
Collaborating closely with Engineering, Product and other technical teams.
Reviewing code and contributing to engineering standards.
Mentoring and supporting other engineers.
Using modern AI-assisted development tools as part of the engineering process.

About You

You’ll have strong experience building production backend software
, but your current language doesn’t need to be Java.

You could come from Java, C#, .NET, Go, Python or another modern backend language
.

What matters is that you have strong engineering fundamentals and are genuinely interested in moving into Java and using it as your main backend language day to day
.

You’ll be comfortable with:

Data structures, algorithms and problem solving.
Object-oriented design and software engineering principles.
Designing and developing APIs.
SQL and relational databases.
System design and distributed systems.
Performance, scalability and reliability.
Testing and production-quality engineering.

Java and Spring Boot
AWS or another major cloud platform
React, JavaScript or TypeScript
Kafka or other event-driven technologies
NoSQL databases
Docker and Kubernetes
CI/CD
Monitoring and observability
AI-assisted coding tools

The Environment

You’ll join an engineering environment where Senior Engineers are trusted to own problems rather than simply complete tickets
.

Location:
Oxfordshire

Hybrid

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100960

Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron-based desktop platform. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

Test automation - approximately 35%: Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end-to-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
CI/CD and build automation - approximately 30%: Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows

Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
Participate in release-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues

Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

Experience developing automated tests for software applications
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 63,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €8 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE is listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

About Our Team

Our Full stack engineering team brings together experienced engineers, diverse perspectives, and a flat team structure that enables visibility and impact from day one. With 40–50 professionals across the practice, we deliver some of the most exciting projects in the market — from next‑generation fintech payment platforms to global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

AI is an important part of our work, but this role is grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals. We are looking for senior engineers who enjoy architecture, system design, and end‑to‑end delivery, with a genuine interest in modern technologies, including AI.

The role requires Security Clearance or ability to get SC in short timescales.

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about building high‑quality software and designing robust systems. You will work on complex, large‑scale solutions across multiple technology stacks, collaborating closely with clients and internal stakeholders. While you will help guide other engineers, this role is engineering‑led rather than people‑management‑focused.

Where Purpose Meets Career

Technology

This is a true full-stack role
, offering exposure to a broad range of technologies and architectures. You will continuously upskill while working alongside highly talented engineers, selecting the most appropriate tools and languages for each challenge.

Contribute to diverse and meaningful projects

From automating government client systems and delivering large‑scale platform migrations, to applying AI to enhance our products — including next‑generation fintech payment platforms and global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

Culture

Our culture is built by people who genuinely love technology. We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and we actively support innovation and knowledge sharing.

Your Future Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will

Design, build, and deploy scalable, high‑quality systems
Translate business and client requirements into technical solutions
Work directly with clients, moving quickly from concept to production
Lead by example through hands‑on development
Contribute to architectural decisions across multiple teams
Support and mentor engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery

What You Bring

A proven track record in full stack development
Experience designing systems and solutions independently
Experience providing technical leadership while staying actively involved in hands‑on development is highly valued.

Experience Required

Solid understanding of maintainable code, systems design and software architecture
Experience working across multiple technology stacks
Strong experience with library‑appropriate, strongly typed languages such as C++, Java, C#, Go or Rust, along with relevant front‑end frameworks
High adaptability and the ability to learn new technologies quickly
Interest in modern technologies such as new languages, AI, cloud platforms
Strong communication skills and confidence working with clients and distributed teams

Your Benefits, Your Way

25 days annual leave, with the option to purchase additional days
Private Healthcare

Income Protection

Flexible benefits, allowing you to tailor your package around wellbeing, family support, and more

Deploy, operate and upgrade Kubernetes clusters (AKS, EKS), including node pool management, networking (CNI, ingress controllers), RBAC and cluster security

Implement observability across platforms and clusters using Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog, with meaningful alerting rather than noise
Support customers' development teams with platform guidance, pipeline design and deployment best practice

Automation and continuous improvement

Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them using PowerShell, Python, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Lambda or similar
Contribute to our internal automation and tooling, helping standardise how we build and run customer environments
Recommend and implement improvements to security posture, resilience and cost efficiency

Customer engagement

Work directly with customers and internal Technical Account Managers to understand requirements and deliver outcomes
Contribute to service reviews and technical roadmap discussions
Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the team

Essential

About you:

Solid hands-on experience with Azure production environments
Strong Terraform experience
Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, ideally AKS or EKS
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Scripting ability in PowerShell, Python and/or Bash
Strong understanding of cloud networking and identity (VNets/VPCs, DNS, private endpoints, VPN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, Entra ID, IAM)
Experience with Docker and container-based application delivery
Comfortable supporting live services within ITIL-based processes and SLAs, using tools such as ServiceNow, ConnectWise or Halo
Clear communicator, able to work directly with customers and their development teams

Desirable

Previous MSP or multi-tenant experience
Terraform Cloud/Enterprise
Serverless (Azure Functions, Lambda) and event-driven architectures
Knowledge of backup and DR tooling (Azure Backup, Veeam, AWS Backup)

Certifications (desirable, or willingness to achieve)

Microsoft: AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305
HashiCorp Terraform Associate
CNCF: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or CKAD

Benefits / Perks

☀️ Time Off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays
🎂 Birthday Leave: One extra day off to celebrate
💰 Company Pension Scheme
📞 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for wellbeing support
🏃‍♀️ EkcOlympics: Global team activity challenges
📚 Unlimited access to Pluralsight for continuous development
🌱 Real opportunities to grow, including international progression

Why Ekco

🏅 Company of the year 2026 Tech Excellence Awards
⭐️ Microsoft’s 2023 Rising Star Security Partner of the Year
🚀 First Irish Microsoft MSP to achieve all four Microsoft Security Specializations
🌈 A culture rooted in diversity, equality, inclusion & belonging
🎉 A commitment to internal mobility and career progression

Operating across both B2B, B2C and internal technology teams, this role exists to bring structure, visibility, and control to a diverse and evolving software landscape shaped by organic and acquisition growth.

With multiple homegrown and proprietary applications primarily built on .NET and LAMP stacks, our engineering teams have historically operated with autonomy in tooling, frameworks, and processes. As we continue to scale, we must now centralise standards around source code management, vulnerability remediation, technical debt allocation, and risk reporting—without disrupting the pace of business value delivery.

The Software Standards Manager acts as the bridge between delivery-focused development teams and compliance, cyber, and risk stakeholders. This role protects engineering capacity by creating a structured intake and prioritisation model for security and compliance requests, ensuring they are logged, translated into backlog items, and progressed in a measurable way.

You will own the catalogue of internally developed applications, maintain visibility of framework lifecycle status, and oversee vulnerability posture across SAST and monitoring tools such as New Relic and Tenable. Through clear weekly reporting and monthly scorecards, you will provide leadership with a single, reliable view of remediation progress and risk exposure.

This is a highly visible and influential role, combining governance, technical literacy and stakeholder management to ensure our software estate is secure and sustainable.

Responsibilities

Technical Role Delivery

Own and maintain a centralised catalogue of all internally developed applications, including framework versions, hosting environments, ownership, and lifecycle status
Drive the centralisation and standardisation of code repository management and software governance practices
Establish and manage a structured intake process for cyber and compliance requirements
Consolidate vulnerability findings from tools such as New Relic, Tenable, and other monitoring platforms
Translate security and compliance findings into clearly defined, prioritised backlog items within Agile workflows
Participate in Agile ceremonies (stands-ups, reviews, retrospectives) to ensure visibility and progress of remediation tasks
Advocate for and track a defined allocation of development capacity toward technical debt and vulnerability remediation
Protect development teams from unstructured or reactive requests by creating a controlled and prioritised engagement model

Performance & Reporting

Act as the primary liaison between Digital, Compliance, and Cyber teams
Design and own structured reporting templates, dashboards, and scorecards
Provide weekly progress updates and monthly governance scorecards to the Head of Department(s) and wider stakeholders
Establish a single source of truth for software risk posture and remediation progress
Clearly communicate risk exposure, remediation velocity, and technical debt reduction trends
Reduce reactive reporting cycles by implementing consistent and predictable governance communications
Support leadership decision-making with accurate, transparent, and actionable insights
Deliver a long-term change program to enable Ping Identity IGA & MFA across all employee-accessed applications

Essential Requirements

Candidate Qualities & Experience

Proven experience working within software engineering environments (Agile/DevOps)
Strong understanding of SDLC, backlog management, and sprint planning processes
Practical experience with vulnerability management and SAST tooling
Ability to interpret technical risk and translate it into prioritised, actionable remediation plans
Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams without direct line management authority
Experience designing and delivering structured reporting to senior stakeholders.
Working knowledge of modern application stacks (including .NET and/or LAMP environments)
Familiarity with cloud hosting environments and application lifecycle management
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline

Highly Desirable Qualities

Experience centralising code repositories and driving engineering standards across multiple teams
Exposure to multi-entity or acquisition-led environments with fragmented technology estates
Experience engaging with Cyber Security and Compliance stakeholders
Experience building governance dashboards or automated reporting metrics
Exposure to SSO and IGA rollout projects (preferably Ping Identity)
Relevant professional certifications, such as:
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Agile/Scrum certifications
ITIL (Service Management)

Personal Attributes

Structured and disciplined thinker who brings order to complex environments
Pragmatic and commercially aware, balancing risk reduction with business value delivery
Calm and credible under pressure, able to manage competing stakeholder demand
Confident communicator who can translate technical detail into executive-level clarity
Resilient and assertive when protecting engineering capacity
Naturally collaborative, building trust across Development, Cyber, Compliance, and Leadership teams
Outcome-focused, with a bias toward measurable progress and continuous improvement

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you’ll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, You’ll

Work with a cross-functional team. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features.
Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you’ll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
Mentor. You’ll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
User-focused. You’re excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

This role offers something more involving.

You’ll join an established software company that is investing in modern development tools and testing approaches. The work spans web, mobile and API-based applications, combining thoughtful manual and exploratory testing with automation. With varied projects, technically interesting problems, and software used at scale, this is an opportunity to keep learning while making a visible contribution to the reliability, security and performance of the product.

Salary is competitive and negotiable, up to around £40,000 per annum depending on experience
Annual salary reviews with regular market benchmarking
Hybrid working – 1 day per week remote from home
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Pension scheme with employer contribution and matched enhancements
Health Cash Plan including 24/7 GP access, dental and optical cover
Death in Service cover (4x salary)
Employee Assistance Programme
Paid volunteering days
Discretionary bonus
Comfortable, modern open-plan office
Team and company social events
Autonomy, trust and long-term career progression

Quality is treated as a shared responsibility, with close collaboration across QA, development, product and DevOps.

At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.
At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your role:
Engineer - IT Manufacturing Execution

As an Engineer at Elanco, you will be a key technical contributor to the digital heart of our production facilities. You will specialize in implementing and supporting our Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). This hands-on role is the critical bridge between our physical manufacturing processes and the digital systems that control and document them, ensuring our operations are efficient, compliant, and reliable.

This includes four strategic priorities:

Pipeline Acceleration: Optimize the search and approval of high impact medicines with a focus on speed, cost and precision.
Manufacturing Excellence: Improve the efficiency, quality and consistency of core manufacturing processes, specifically execution and equipment effectiveness.
Sales Effectiveness: Simplify the process to find, trust and consume relevant customer insights that drive sales growth and improved engagement.
Productivity: Expand operating margin through efficiency by systematically reducing our operating expenses across the company, improving profitability.

Your Responsibilities:

System Design and Configuration: Contribute to the design and be responsible for the configuration and implementation of MES solutions. This includes building and modifying electronic batch records (EBRs), system workflows, and configuring equipment integration based on defined requirements.
Process Optimization: Collaborate with operations and quality teams to analyze manufacturing and laboratory workflows. You will use MES capabilities to help implement process improvements, reduce production cycle times, and enhance data integrity at the shop-floor level.
System Management and Support: Provide frontline technical support for MES platforms. You will act as a key technical resource to troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring high availability for our manufacturing and lab teams.
Integration: Assist with the integration between MES and other critical systems, such as our ERP (SAP), and shop-floor equipment (PLCs/SCADA), ensuring a reliable flow of data.
Validation and Compliance: Execute validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) for MES enhancements and new implementations. You will be responsible for generating validation documentation and ensuring systems are maintained in a validated state, compliant with GxP and data integrity requirements.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Operations, Quality Assurance, and Process Science teams to gather system requirements and provide updates on technical activities.
User Training and Enablement: Develop training materials and conduct training sessions to ensure that manufacturing and lab personnel are proficient in using the MES/LES systems effectively in their day-to-day roles.

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering (e.g., Industrial, Chemical, Manufacturing, Computer Science) or a related technical field or equivalent experience.
Required Experience: 3+ years hands-on experience with the configuration, and support of an MES platform (e.g., Tulip, Werum PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, POMSnet).
Manufacturing Environment Experience: Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biologics, animal health, or another GxP-regulated industry.
Regulatory Knowledge: A working knowledge of GxP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and familiarity with computer system validation (CSV) principles.
Process Control Understanding: Familiarity with industrial automation concepts, including PLCs, SCADA, and how they integrate with higher-level manufacturing systems.
Database and SQL Skills: Experience with SQL for data queries to support troubleshooting, data extraction, and report generation.

What Will Give You the Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to systematically diagnose and resolve technical issues.
Process Analysis: A solid understanding of business process analysis and workflow design. Ability to read and interpret process maps and requirements documents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment with operators, scientists, and management.
Cloud Platform Proficiency: Familiarity with Public Cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is a plus.
DevSecOps: Familiarity with the concepts of DevSecOps, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and source control (Git), is desirable.
Communication Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a technical team.

Additional Information:

Travel: 0-10%
Location: Hook, UK - Hybrid Work Environment or Speke, UK – Hybrid Work Environment

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delinea’s leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle – across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Site Reliability Engineer Summary

Our growing technology company is seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer with deep Azure expertise to help maintain the availability, performance, and reliability of our critical SaaS applications. In this role, you will own and drive automation, monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure improvements across our multi-cloud, multi-region environment, working closely with senior engineering and cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

Own the availability and performance of production SaaS applications running on Azure (AKS, App Service, Redis, SQL, Service Bus etc), across multiple geographic regions.
Lead troubleshooting and resolution of cloud infrastructure and application issues, including AKS pod/node failures, deployment rollbacks, ingress and networking issues, and resource/autoscaling problems.
Participate in an on-call rotation (including weekends) and drive incident response from detection through resolution, with a primary focus on customer experience and minimizing impact.
Drive improvements to disaster recovery, failover, and incident management processes across multi-region deployments.
Build and maintain automation scripts and monitoring tools to reduce manual toil and streamline operational tasks.
Author post-incident reviews (RCAs), identify root causes, and drive preventive action items to closure.
Partner with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to implement and improve reliability, observability, and performance best practices.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across infrastructure, tooling, and process.
Communicate clearly with customer-facing stakeholders when incidents require external status updates or written incident summaries.

What You’ll Need

5+ years of relevant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Administration, with demonstrated ownership of production systems.
Hands-on experience administering Azure environments, including AKS (Kubernetes), core Azure services, cloud networking, and cloud security fundamentals.
Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting practices (e.g., Datadog, Azure Monitor, ELK stack), including hands-on troubleshooting with log analysis and stack traces using Datadog APM.
Familiarity with networking fundamentals: firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, DNS, and routing.
Experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or similar).
Practical understanding of backup, redundancy, and disaster recovery strategies in cloud environments, including geo-redundant / multi-region deployments.
Strong ownership mindset across the full incident lifecycle, from detection through post-mortem, with a customer-first approach.
Comfort communicating clearly and professionally in written form, including incident status updates and post-incident summaries.

We’d Love To See

Experience with AWS Cloud Platform.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or ARM templates.
Prior experience operating SaaS products with regional tenant architectures (e.g., multiple geo-specific production environments).

Why work at Delinea?

We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do
Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments
Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team
Ownership - We take initiative and follow through
Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

All the details

What You’ll Do

Your key accountabilities will include

Lead the design of end-to-end analytics and AI solutions across Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power Platform and Copilot, guiding delivery teams from architecture through to production and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure and business aligned.

Who You Are

Your skills and experience will include

An experienced Analytics Solutions Architect with a proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale analytics and AI solutions, in a Microsoft-centric environment, using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power Platform and Copilot Studio.
Ability to be strategic and hands-on. Can translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure and maintainable solution architectures, while remaining comfortable working close to delivery teams.
An influential communicator and collaborator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders, build trusted relationships and communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A champion of governance and engineering excellence, experienced in defining standards, best practices and reusable architectural patterns that enable teams to deliver consistently, securely and at scale.
