About The Role

The University of Cambridge's Information Services is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer. You will join a multidisciplinary development team within a Division of 50 engineers building high-profile bespoke web systems and cloud-native services, and modernising existing applications.

This is a hybrid position, with amazing benefits, like a defined benefit pension and 41 days of annual leave inclusive of public holidays.

Our services are public-facing and support University staff and students (~60,000 people), meaning your work will have a significant impact on the reputation of one of the world's leading universities. We develop new services using modern web architectural standards with an emphasis on reusability, APIs, test automation, and CI. Services are deployed to cloud infrastructure in Docker containers.

Our technology stack is published in our Guidebook and comprises technologies like Google Cloud, Terraform, Docker, Python, Django, React, and TypeScript. We maintain a DevOps culture and use Scrum for our day-to-day work. We have also adopted an "open by default" approach to new work and thus you can find much of our work to date in our GitLab. The team also produces a Guidebook that collects the team's practices and useful information at https://guidebook.devops.uis.cam.ac.uk/

What we're looking for

You will be highly skilled in modern software development, testing, security, and operations, and be an expert in:

Architecting secure-by-design web applications and APIs with a focus on maintainability and stability, using clean code.

Integrating applications via APIs, event buses, and asynchronous tasks.

Writing expert-level Python and Django, with working knowledge of TypeScript and React (or comparable languages and frameworks).

Packaging web applications in Docker containers.

Writing and applying efficient tests with good knowledge of testing frameworks and testing best practices.

Conducting thorough code reviews.

Using AI coding assistants effectively, writing clear prompts, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and taking responsibility for its correctness, security, and maintainability.

Building CI/CD pipelines in GitLab to test and deploy web applications to the cloud using Terraform.

Working with Google Cloud or similar cloud platforms.

Managing software requirements, priorities, and dependencies.

Driving improvements in technical architecture, standards, and processes, and choosing the right solution for the problem (switching off, extending, building, or buying).

Debug effectively in unfamiliar applications.

Ways Of Working

Work in cross-functional teams using a DevOps approach, mentoring more junior engineers.

Communicate clearly in both written and verbal forms, and collaborate with University colleagues, users, and business representatives to gather and refine detailed requirements.

Focus on delivery while taking a continuous-improvement approach to existing services.

Learn new skills proactively and stay current with modern practices.

Apply AI tools pragmatically as they evolve, without compromising the quality, security, or ownership of the code you ship.

Work across products and teams to build consistent architectures, thinking through their impact on other services and the wider organisation.

Understand specifications and produce simple architectures from complex problems.

Drive work to completion, adjusting pace to the urgency of the task.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Ecotricity, the UK’s first true green energy provider, has a strong internal technology team building solutions across mission-critical platforms. The Senior Engineer will create solutions that use artificial intelligence to solve real business problems, with AWS/Databricks as the core production platform and Claude and Codex supporting the engineering workflow. This is a hands-on role spanning discovery, software delivery and the reliable operation of live services

Responsibilities

Own the design, build, deployment and ongoing operation of production-grade AI-enabled data products on AWS and Databricks.
Work with stakeholders to define the user problem, measurable outcomes, data requirements and a pragmatic technical approach.
Prototype rapidly with Claude, Codex and other approved AI tooling, then turn successful concepts into secure, maintainable software.
Build reliable data pipelines, APIs and back-end services, together with front-end web or app experiences where the product requires them.
Apply strong software engineering practices including code review, automated testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation and infrastructure as code.
Create evaluation, monitoring and observability for data quality, model or LLM behaviour, service reliability, performance and cost.
Protect sensitive data and apply appropriate security, privacy, governance and responsible AI controls throughout the product lifecycle.
Operate and support live services, resolve faults swiftly, reduce technical debt and share practical knowledge with the wider team.

About the team

The Ecotricity Technology department is a small friendly team with a strong focus on getting results, with everyone committed to delivering both individually and as part of the group/project.

We have a training programme in place to further advance your skills, with dedicated learning time planned into our workloads. Relevant training and certifications, including Databricks and AWS, are supported by the company, alongside opportunities to deepen applied AI and software engineering skills.

We’re proud to be an ethical company, and this naturally attracts ethical people, making for a good safe working environment and a team that works and wins together. We also have a competitive benefits package and chose to invest in our people whenever we can.

About You

Are you an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business problems and data into useful, production-ready products? We are looking for a practical Senior Engineer who can take ownership from early discovery and prototyping through to deployment, adoption and support.

You will design and build end-to-end AI-enabled solutions on AWS and Databricks. Depending on the problem, this may pipelines, APIs, backend services and user-facing websites or applications.

We value sound engineering judgement over using AI for its own sake. You will select the simplest effective approach, prove value quickly, and then engineer for security, performance, cost, maintainability and scale. Experience in the energy industry is helpful but not essential.

You will work closely with product owners, project managers, subject-matter experts, data teams and other stakeholders. You will explain options clearly, demonstrate working software, gather feedback and translate it into measurable product outcomes.

This is a hybrid role, you will be self-motivated, delivery-focused and comfortable driving work independently. You will also contribute to shared engineering standards, review the work of peers and actively develop your own skills as AI tooling evolves.

If you want to build responsible AI products that move beyond prototypes and deliver tangible value in a dynamic, purpose-led organisation, we encourage you to apply.

Knowledge And Skills

Experience building and operating production software, data products or applied AI systems.
Strong Python, including experience designing APIs and integrating external services.
Practical experience with Databricks
Experience deploying secure, scalable workloads on AWS.
Understanding of applied AI and LLM patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, structured extraction and evaluation.
Effective use of AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex, with the judgement to review, test and own the resulting code.
Strong software delivery practices using GitHub or Bitbucket, automated testing and CI/CD.
Ability to build usable front-end web or app experiences using TypeScript, React or a comparable framework.
Clear communication, product thinking and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Advantageous

MLflow, RAG, Vector Search or comparable model and AI application tooling.
Terraform and automated AWS infrastructure delivery.
Container-based deployment, serverless services or modern application observability.
UX or product design experience for internal or customer-facing applications.
Experience of the energy industry or other regulated, data-sensitive environments.

About Us

What's in it for you...

Healthcare plan, life assurance and generous pension contribution

Volunteering Day

Hybrid Working

Various company discounts (including shops, gyms, days out and events)

Holiday of 25 days (plus bank holidays) & ability to buy/sell days

Cycle to work scheme, car pooling and onsite parking available

As a valued member of the team, you will be supporting the Group Environmental Policy and its associated sustainability objectives and targets.

Flexibility Statement

The fast moving nature of the business means that from time to time you may be asked to perform duties or tasks outside of your original job description on an ad hoc basis. This allows the company to utilise our people in the best possible way at all times and helps our colleagues to make the best contribution in a changing environment.

Ecotricity is Britain's overall greenest energy company- it’s more than just green energy – the breadth and depth of our work on green issues is unmatched. When we started back in 1995, we were the first company in the world to provide a new kind of electricity - the green kind.

Our mission was, and remains, to change the way energy is made and used in Britain - by replacing fossil fuels with clean, renewable energy.

We don't just supply green energy, we use the money from our customers' bills to make it ourselves too – we have built windmills and sun parks in Britain. We call this turning 'bills into mills'.

We don't just focus on energy though- we built the Electric Highway, Britain's leading network of electric vehicle charging points; we helped Forest Green Rovers become the greenest football club in the world; and we launched Britain's greenest mobile phone service, Ecotalk, where they use the money from their customers' bills to protect and regenerate Britain's lost rainforests.

Ecotricity is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to providing equality for all.

jobs.description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.

Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.

We connect. We inspire.

Contract type
: 1-year Fixed Term Contract

Pay band
: 7/F

Hours:
Full time, 36 hours per week

Salary:
£32,381 – £38,267, depending on the candidate’s experience, plus a £3,300 London Market Allowance

Location
: UK - London only

Closing Date:
4th October 2026

Please note that candidates must have the pre-existing (permanent) legal right to work in the UK at the time of application. Visa Sponsorship and relocation assistance is not provided.

Role Context

The British Council builds connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and other countries through arts and culture, education, and the English language. We work in two ways - directly with individuals to transform their lives, and with governments and partners to make a bigger difference for the longer term, creating benefit for millions of people all over the world. We help young people to gain the skills, confidence, and connections they are looking for to realise their potential and to participate in strong and inclusive communities. We support them to learn English, to get a high-quality education and to gain internationally recognised qualifications. Our work in arts and culture stimulates creative expression and exchange and nurtures creative enterprise. We connect the best of the UK with the world and the best of the world with the UK.

The role sits as part of the Data Evidence and Performance (DEP) team, which is part of the Global Operations function and includes the central oversight and leadership for corporate planning, performance management, evaluation and reporting, the management of strategic risk and of investment, internal audit, shared services, marketing, digital and technology. DEP provides the central leadership and development for the British Council’s Data Analytics and Evidence Strategy working across the organisation with stakeholders to leverage our Data and Evidence assets. This includes driving better data quality through enterprise data governance, designing and delivering data technology and insight solutions, co-ordinating an organisational community of practice for Data Analytics and Evidence, development of the British Council KPIs framework, monitoring and reviewing performance to drive improvement, evaluation, and measurement of impact to help improve decision making.

Role Purpose

The Associate AI Engineer is part of the Data Science and Analytics team, helping to establish and build the British Council enterprise approach to Data Evidence and Performance. The role is responsible for developing, implementing, deploying and maintaining AI-enabled applications and services, working with data scientists, data engineers and Digital and Technology colleagues. The postholder applies good software engineering, cloud, security and responsible AI practices to deliver reliable, user-centred solutions, while continuing to build their technical capability.

Main Accountabilities

Function Support and Service Improvement

AI Application Development

Work with the Data Scientist and cross-functional teams to develop AI-enabled applications and services, including working closely with data engineering and Digital and Technology teams.
Develop user-facing and backend components using appropriate technologies, including Microsoft Power Apps where suitable and Python or JavaScript-based services where pro-code is required.
Use Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning and other Azure AI services to build and integrate AI capabilities.
Build, test and evaluate AI and generative AI components, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic or vector search and agent-based patterns where appropriate.

Application Deployment And Support

Deploy AI applications and models to internal customers, ensuring effective integration, reliability, security and functionality.
Monitor and troubleshoot developed applications and services, resolving faults and supporting continuous improvement.
Apply British Council requirements for information security, data protection, accessibility and responsible AI, including appropriate testing and controls for AI-specific risks.

Agile Development

Work in an agile development environment, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
Own defined work packages, prioritise tasks with the team and deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines.

Relationship and Stakeholder Management

Support the development of customer-centric and insight-led working.
Collaborate with team members, stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand user and business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly.

Leadership and management (self-development)

Complete British Council induction, mandatory training and role-related learning.
Keep technical knowledge current across AI, software engineering and cloud technologies, applying learning to practical delivery.
Seek feedback and mentoring, contribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing, and take responsibility for continuous professional development

Minimum/essential

Requirements of the role

Degree-level qualification or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant STEM discipline.
Applied AI engineering. Practical experience, gained through employment, internship, academic work or substantial projects, of building AI or machine learning applications.
Programming and software engineering. Proficiency in Python and experience with APIs, JSON, Git/version control and testing. Familiarity with SQL and software development practices.
Generative AI and machine learning. Practical understanding of large language models and common patterns such as prompt engineering, embeddings or vector search, RAG and agentic workflows, plus familiarity with at least one machine learning or AI framework or SDK.
Cloud and deployment. Practical exposure to Azure or another major cloud platform for developing or deploying applications, with an understanding of CI/CD, containers and monitoring concepts.
Responsible delivery and collaboration. Understanding of information security, data protection and responsible AI risks, and the ability to work in an agile, multidisciplinary team and communicate technical issues clearly

Desirable

Microsoft AI stack. Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning or related Azure AI services.
AI engineering tools. Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain or LlamaIndex, and with vector databases or semantic search.
Full-stack delivery. Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, REST APIs and frontend or low-code development such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Microsoft Power Apps.

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. Job Description

The Opportunity

Today, EF English Live does not consistently apply appropriate QA coverage to relevant Salesforce and Web tickets before release. Volume has outpaced our current QA capacity, so coverage gaps happen, and where testing does happen it often leans towards happy-path checks rather than risk-based regression testing. We already use AIO for automation and want to build on it further, and more hands are needed to close the coverage gap in the meantime.

This role is about adding real capacity: hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, with risk-based coverage applied according to the nature and impact of each change, plus active support extending and complementing our existing AIO automation. Our existing QA lead will continue to own and drive the automation strategy; this hire works alongside them, splitting time between hands-on testing and helping extend that automation over time.

Role Overview

This is a fixed-term contract engagement, initially for 4 to 6 months. The Senior QA Automation Engineer will provide thorough, hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based coverage according to the nature and impact of each change, while also helping extend and complement our existing AIO automation. This is a genuinely hybrid role: meaningful hands-on testing capacity now, and a growing share of automation work over time , done in close partnership with our existing QA lead rather than in place of them.

Within 3 Months, Success Looks Like

All relevant Salesforce and Web tickets receiving appropriate QA coverage before release, with risk-based testing applied according to the nature and impact of the change.
Regression testing meaningfully expanded beyond happy-path checks.
Our existing AIO automation extended and complemented, with additional tooling or approaches identified where they would provide better coverage or maintainability.
The existing QA lead measurably better supported, with more capacity across the team rather than the load resting on one person.

Main Responsibilities

Hands-On QA Coverage (Salesforce & Web)

Provide thorough manual and exploratory testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based testing according to the nature and impact of each change.
Prioritise regression testing, not just happy-path checks, to reduce the risk of shipping undetected issues.

Test Automation & Tooling

Extend and complement our existing AIO automation, identifying where additional tooling or approaches would provide better coverage or maintainability.
Work alongside the existing QA lead, who owns the overall automation strategy and roadmap, contributing hands-on automation build where needed.

Collaboration & Capability Building

Work alongside the existing QA lead and engineering team to raise the overall QA bar, across both tooling and process.
Partner with Business Systems and engineering leads to prioritise coverage based on commercial risk.

Reporting

Report to Business Systems Engineering leadership, with visibility on release risk and quality metrics shared with the wider team.

Technical Background & Skills

Core Experience

Strong hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience across web applications and, ideally, CRM/Salesforce environments.
Experience in automating tests using Javascript /Typescript frameworks (e.g. Nightwatch.js, Cypress, Playwright)
Experience with API and integration testing, including validating data flows between Salesforce, web applications and third-party systems.
Comfortable splitting time between hands-on ticket testing and automation work, rather than being purely one or the other.

Ways of Working

Genuinely hybrid: as comfortable manually testing a ticket as contributing to an automation framework.
Collaborative: complements and supports the existing QA lead's automation strategy rather than working around it.
Pragmatic about what to automate first, while making sure day-to-day coverage across Salesforce and Web doesn't slip in the meantime.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

Our ambition is to build a best-in-class internal data and technology ecosystem - connected, scalable and increasingly AI-enabled. As a finance transformation and technology consultancy, we want the way we operate internally to reflect the same standards and ambition we bring to our clients.
This is a hands-on role. You'll set the direction and architecture, but you'll also build, configure, integrate and improve the solutions behind it. You'll inherit an active roadmap, deliver immediate improvements and help shape what our future technology and data landscape should look like.
The challenge isn't simply technical. You'll work across the business to understand requirements, prioritise competing needs, make recommendations and lead change through to adoption.
We need someone equally comfortable stepping back to design the right solution and getting stuck in to make it work.

Our tech stack

You'll be working across a broad and evolving technology landscape, including:
Microsoft 365 | NetSuite | Sage | CCH Tagetik | Attio | n8n | Zapier | SQL | Power BI | Rippling | Cledara | Notion | Rocketlane | Claude

You don't need to have worked with every platform. We're more interested in your ability to understand how systems, data and workflows fit together, learn new technologies quickly and design better ways of connecting them.

What you'll own

Data & systems architecture

Own the architecture across our core internal systems, data and integrations.
Design clean, scalable data models and flows across commercial, delivery, finance and operational platforms.
Set clear standards for data quality, governance, integrations and development.
Identify architectural weaknesses, duplication and manual processes and design pragmatic solutions.
Balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability.

Automation & AI

Identify where automation and AI can materially improve how the business operates.
Design and build automated workflows across systems and teams.
Explore and implement practical AI-enabled solutions, agents and new ways of using AI to configure and improve our systems and workflows.
Reduce manual processing, re-keying and unnecessary administration.
Help us scale the use of AI and automation across the organisation.
Measure impact through time saved, better data, reduced errors and improved decision-making.

Build & execution

Pick up our existing systems and data roadmap and move quickly into delivery.
Build and configure solutions directly, working with external developers or suppliers where needed.
Prototype ideas, test approaches and deliver quick wins alongside longer-term architecture.
Diagnose and resolve issues across systems, integrations and data flows.
Maintain appropriate technical documentation and development standards.

Roadmap & change

Own and maintain a prioritised roadmap across data, systems, automation and AI.
Gather requirements and translate business needs into clear technical plans and solutions.
Manage multiple initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption.
Communicate progress, dependencies, decisions and risks clearly.
Ensure changes work for the people using them - not just technically.

Business partnership

Build a strong understanding of how VantagePoint operates across sales, delivery, finance and operations.
Translate business problems into practical technology and data solutions.
Present recommendations and options clearly to senior stakeholders.
Bring structure to ambiguous problems and help prioritise where technology investment will create the greatest value.
Act as a trusted internal advisor while remaining close enough to the detail to deliver.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who understands the technology, sees the bigger business picture and knows how to turn both into practical solutions.

You’ll bring a strong combination of:

Data architecture, data engineering, systems architecture or software engineering experience.
Designing data models, integrations and end-to-end data flows.
Strong hands-on SQL capability and experience with relational databases.
Python or another development language used to solve real business problems.
APIs, integrations and cloud-based architectures.
Workflow automation and low-code/no-code tooling.
BI and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.
Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Practical application of AI, LLMs, agents or AI-enabled automation.
Experience working across CRM, ERP, finance, project or operational systems - experience with some of our current technology stack would be beneficial, but isn't essential.

Just as importantly, you'll be someone who:

Can think strategically without disappearing into strategy.
Enjoys being hands-on and building solutions, not just designing them.
Can take an ambiguous problem and turn it into a structured plan.
Prioritises effectively and keeps delivery moving.
Communicates confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Can challenge senior stakeholders constructively and explain your reasoning.
Understands that successful technology change is as much about people and adoption as architecture.
Takes ownership and follows things through.
Enjoys working in a fast-moving environment where not everything has already been defined.

What success looks like

Within your first 6-12 months:
We have a clear, prioritised data, systems, automation and AI roadmap.
Our core systems have cleaner, more scalable integrations and data flows.
High-value manual processes have been removed or automated.
AI and automation are embedded into how we operate, delivering measurable improvements to our systems and workflows.
Technical decisions and architecture are better documented and governed.
Teams understand what's changing, why and when.
Leadership has confidence that our internal technology landscape can support the next stage of VantagePoint's growth.

Why VantagePoint?

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of how technology, data and AI support a growing global business.
You'll join with an active roadmap and plenty to get stuck into from day one, but with genuine scope to shape what comes next. You'll work directly with senior leadership, challenge and improve how we operate, and see the impact of what you build across the business.
For someone who enjoys solving complex problems and building rather than simply maintaining, there's significant scope to make this role your own.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary and performance bonus, we offer:
Up to 10% matched pension contribution
Private healthcare
Life cover
Hybrid working
Free travel to the London office
Gym or wellbeing allowance
EAP – Employee Assistance Programme
Monthly phone allowance
Paid company socials
Cycle to Work scheme

Our values

Thrive together
- we win as one team

Take ownership
- accountability for outcomes, not just tasks

Quality, every time
- consistent, well-judged delivery

Be human, first
- trust, empathy and respect

Speak with clarity
- open, direct, low ego

Move with intent
- decisive, reflective, always improving

Our recruitment process

Our recruitment process is designed to be straightforward and give both sides the opportunity to assess fit. Depending on the role, shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short video questionnaire or practical assessment ahead of interview.

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 63,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €8 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

With 40–50 professionals across the practice, we deliver some of the most exciting projects in the market — from nextgeneration fintech payment platforms to global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

AI is an important part of our work, but this role is grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals. We are looking for senior engineers who enjoy architecture, system design, and endtoend delivery, with a genuine interest in modern technologies, including AI.

The role requires Security Clearance or ability to get SC in short timescales.

You will work on complex, large‑scale solutions across multiple technology stacks, collaborating closely with clients and internal stakeholders. While you will help guide other engineers, this role is engineering‑led rather than people‑management‑focused.

This is a true full stack role
, offering exposure to a broad range of technologies and architectures. You will continuously upskill while working alongside highly talented engineers, selecting the most appropriate tools and languages for each challenge.

Contribute to diverse and meaningful projects

From automating government client systems and delivering large‑scale platform migrations, to applying AI to enhance our products — including next‑generation fintech payment platforms and global insurance systems deployed across multiple countries.

Culture

Our culture is built by people who genuinely love technology. We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and we actively support innovation and knowledge sharing.

Your Future Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will

Design, build, and deploy scalable, high‑quality systems
Translate business and client requirements into technical solutions
Work directly with clients, moving quickly from concept to production
Lead by example through hands‑on development
Contribute to architectural decisions across multiple teams
Support and mentor engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery

What You Bring

A proven track record in full stack development
Experience designing systems and solutions independently
Experience providing technical leadership while staying actively involved in hands‑on development is highly valued.

Experience Required

Solid understanding of maintainable code, systems design and software architecture
Experience working across multiple technology stacks

Strong communication skills and confidence working with clients and distributed teams

Private Healthcare
Life Assurance

Flexible benefits, allowing you to tailor your package around wellbeing, family support, and more

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering – Financial Services | £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits | Paddington, London – 4 Days Office

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting financial services and trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience leading an engineering function or large engineering team within a complex technology environment.
• Strong background in software engineering, ideally with experience across development, data engineering and QA
.
• Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices and data platforms.
• Experience with C#/.NET would be highly advantageous.
• Strong understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
• Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
• Comfortable operating at both a strategic and technical level, with the ability to engage with engineers as well as senior business stakeholders.
• Experience working with complex data environments or high-volume, real-time systems.
• Financial services, capital markets, trading or commodities experience would be highly advantageous.

• A strong communicator who can provide clear technical direction while giving engineering teams the autonomy to deliver.

Compensation
: Up to £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Location
: Paddington, London
Working Pattern

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4+ years of automation engineering experience with Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright using C#/.NET and xUnit frameworks.

Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate testing activities, defect management, and issue resolution across development teams.

Proactive approach to quality, testability, production monitoring, and continuous improvement throughout the software development lifecycle.
Good spoken and written English.

Opportunity to shape testing strategy and improve automation practices for a flagship product used globally.
Hands-on work across manual testing, automation, API testing, CI/CD validation, production quality monitoring, and defect management.
Close collaboration with experienced developers, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Corporate support for personal growth and career development, provision of all necessary equipment, and benefits including medical package, Multisport, life insurance, and the internal Wellbeing program.

Poland.

PLN 20,000–24,000 gross per month, with flexibility depending on seniority and experience, plus 5% bonus.

ITRex - AI pioneers who build systems that actually work in the real world, not just in demos. We're 250+ people spread across the US and Europe, creating solutions for companies like Procter & Gamble and Shutterstock. We keep it simple, build it right, and focus on what works.

Pair with other engineers on hard problems and share context instead of hoarding it

Core Java: Java 11 and Java 17, the concurrency model, collections, memory behaviour and the language features that actually changed how modern services are written

English at B2 level or above

Experience introducing AI-assisted workflows to a team: prompt and context practices, review discipline, guardrails for generated code
Prior work in a lead or tech-lead capacity on a distributed backend

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100672

We are seeking an Principal Solution Architect to lead the evolution of Autodesk Consulting’s Intellectual Property platform as an enterprise-ready SaaS product powered by knowledge architecture, AI-enabled capabilities, and future agentic applications.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, and consulting teams, you will design the knowledge architecture that connects workflows, data, decisions, and insights across the AEC, MFG, and M&E domains. You will establish the semantic models, knowledge graph capabilities, and platform architecture required to support organizational change management, workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications.

This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Sr. Manager, Architecture.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the architectural vision for Workflow Advisory and related knowledge-driven platform capabilities
Design semantic architectures, knowledge models, and knowledge graph capabilities that connect workflows, data, decisions, and insights
Define architecture patterns that enable workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications
Establish standards for knowledge representation, lifecycle management, governance, and reuse across platforms
Translate business workflows into reusable domain models, services, and architectural patterns
Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native architectures that support enterprise and customer-facing solutions
Ensure platform services, APIs, and knowledge assets are discoverable, composable, and consumable by AI-enabled applications
Apply AI and LLM technologies to improve knowledge discovery, workflow execution, and advisory experiences
Collaborate with architects and engineering responsible for ensuring architecture meets enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and SOC2 requirements
Collaborate with product, engineering, and consulting teams to align architecture investments with business outcomes and technology strategy
Drive adoption of architectural standards and reusable platform capabilities across teams
Mentor engineers and architects while communicating architectural direction to senior leadership and stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of experience designing and delivering complex software platforms
Experience as a Software Architect, Product Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent technical leadership role
Experience designing AI-enabled, knowledge-driven, or workflow-centric software systems
Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, ontologies, taxonomies, graph databases, or retrieval systems
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG architectures, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agent patterns
Experience leading technical spikes, rapid prototyping efforts, or proof-of-concept development
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices
Experience designing secure, privacy-conscious, and trustworthy software platforms that operate within enterprise governance requirements
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 15% of the time is required

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Poland based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 238,000 PLN and 348,700 PLN. jobs.description:

26WD96547

Senior Principal Software Engineer (Backend/Full Stack)

Location:
Krakow, Poland (Hybrid)

Position Overview

Autodesk is expanding its engineering presence in Krakow and is looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer
(Backend/Full Stack) to help shape the future of our Smart Factory and Facility Operations platforms. While the target solutions are focused on Go (Golang) and React/JavaScript/TypeScript, we are open to candidates with experience in other technology stacks as well.

You will work across teams and disciplines to build our next-generation cloud web application platform – Tandem – that connects data and workflows across Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT (IIoT), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Digital Twin solutions.

This is a high-impact technical leadership (tech lead) role focused on driving platform strategy and architecture (partnering with experienced Autodesk senior architects) and delivering scalable cloud-native services that support mission-critical customer workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to influence technical direction, solve complex software engineering challenges, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with design and development.

Join us in building software for people who design and make the world around us. From advanced manufacturing, sustainable buildings and resilient infrastructure to media experiences, Autodesk empowers innovators to solve complex challenges through technology.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end delivery of major web application initiatives, from technical strategy and system design through implementation and operational excellence.
Design and build scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native services that support high-volume production workloads – with a focus on backend services while contributing to frontend development when needed.
Partner with Autodesk Architects and Engineering Leaders to define and drive the technical vision and architecture for critical platform services.
Contribute hands-on to software development across full-stack technologies with a focus on Go/C++ backends and React frontends (flexibly adapting to other technologies where appropriate)
Establish engineering standards, architectural patterns, and best practices that improve platform quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering leaders to align technical investments with business objectives.
Guide teams through complex technical challenges, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery goals.
Lead design reviews, provide technical mentorship, and elevate engineering excellence across multiple teams.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Champion operational excellence through observability, automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement practices.
Participate in Agile planning and execution activities while helping teams continuously improve delivery practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale commercial software systems.
Strong experience designing distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native web applications and APIs
Proven experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex software platform initiatives spanning multiple teams
Deep expertise in software engineering, with strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Go (Golang), C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, C#, Python, Java or similar (experience with Go and C++ is particularly valued)
Experience with any modern cloud platform such as AWS (preferred) or Azure.
Strong understanding of data architecture and database technologies.
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery practices.
Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with industrial and manufacturing domains (design, simulation, digital twin, operations), Smart Factory/Industry 4.0 solutions, Industrial IoT (IIoT), facility operations, asset management, AEC etc.
Experience with WebGL, 3D visualization technologies and micro-frontends.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.

Hos oss arbetar du i uppdrag där arkitektur, säkerhet och långsiktiga teknikval spelar en avgörande roll för kundens verksamhet. Det kan handla om att ta fram molnstrategier, etablera styrning och säkerhetsprinciper eller stötta kunder i resan till en modern och säker Azure-plattform som möjliggör framtida utveckling inom AI, automatisering och nya digitala tjänster.

Vi erbjuder en trygg och professionell miljö där samarbete, kvalitet och långsiktighet står i centrum. Här arbetar du nära kunder, utvecklingsteam och andra specialister, med möjlighet att påverka både tekniska vägval och strategier.

Är du den vi söker?

Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:
designa och etablera säkra Azure-plattformar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar
ta fram molnstrategier och målbilder för kunders fortsatta utveckling
etablera styrning, säkerhetsprinciper och hållbara arbetssätt
vägleda kunder i frågor som identitet, nätverk, säkerhet och plattformsarkitektur
stötta utvecklingsteam kring DevOps, Infrastructure as Code och automatisering
omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar som håller över tid

Du behöver inte vara expert på allt - men vi tror att du är trygg i arkitektrollen, uppskattar komplexa miljöer och trivs med att ta ansvar för helheten.

Vad du kan arbeta med hos oss

Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdrag, men kan exempelvis innebära:

Molnarkitektur och plattformsutveckling
arkitektur och design av Azure-plattformar
etablering av Azure Landing Zones och plattformsstrukturer för säker och skalbar drift
plattformsarkitektur, styrning och säkerhetsprinciper
nätverksdesign och identitetshantering
arbete med Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) och andra etablerade arbetssätt för molntransformation

Säkerhet och efterlevnad
Zero Trust-principer
IAM och Entra ID
säkerhetsarkitektur i molnmiljöer
lösningar för verksamheter med höga krav på säkerhet, robusthet och efterlevnad

Automation & DevOps
Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform
automatisering av plattformar och miljöer
CI/CD och DevOps-arbetssätt
containerbaserade lösningar och Kubernetes

Strategi och rådgivning
molnstrategier och långsiktiga teknikval
roadmap-arbete och plattformsutveckling
workshops, rådgivning och förstudier
rådgivning kring hur moderna molnplattformar kan stödja områden som AI, automatisering och säker digitalisering

Vilka vi tror att du är

Vi tror att du:
har minst fem års erfarenhet av cloud- och platformsarkitektur, med kompetens inom Azure
har arbetat med säkerhetsdesign och arkitektur i molnmiljöer
är van att arbeta i komplexa och affärskritiska IT-miljöer
har erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code och moderna DevOps-principer
är nyfiken på nya tekniker och ser möjligheter inom områden som AI, automatisering och cybersäkerhet
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska med både tekniska team och verksamhetsrepresentanter
uppskattar att kombinera strategiskt tänkande med tekniskt genomförande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Kubernetes eller Azure-certifieringar.

Trygga uppdrag där din kompetens gör skillnad

Som arkitekt hos oss får du arbeta i uppdrag som är:
affärskritiska – där molnplattformen är central för verksamheten
långsiktiga – med möjlighet att påverka både strategi och genomförande
tekniskt utmanande – med höga krav på säkerhet, skalbarhet och tillgänglighet
varierande – från förstudier och arkitekturarbete till implementation och vidareutveckling

Vi matchar dig utifrån din kompetens och dina ambitioner – inte mot första bästa uppdrag.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Europe's public institutions serve hundreds of millions of people, and most lack the AI infrastructure to do it well. Intric is changing that. Our sovereign AI platform is already used by 70+ municipalities, governments, and institutions. We've built a leading position in Sweden and are expanding across Europe.

What You'll Do

Be the technical owner within customer engagements, working alongside sales and customer success from pre-sales through go-live
Build integrations across APIs, authentication systems, data pipelines, and document platforms
Deploy Intric in on-prem and private cloud environments with strict security requirements
Debug what no one else can figure out, in environments with limited tooling and high constraints
Turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions customers rely on daily
Prioritize ruthlessly across competing demands, from a position of knowledge rather than whoever is loudest
Feed real-world deployment insights back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap

Who you are

You've shipped things that other people depend on. You've been on-call when they broke. You've dealt with real production risk, real failure, and end-to-end ownership without a safety net. That background is what makes the rest of this possible.

You work across the full stack without needing to hand off: frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI layer, GitOps, networking, protocols, raw API work
You take ownership of customer outcomes, not individual tasks. If the customer isn't reaching their goal, that's your problem to solve.
You can say no to the wrong thing and yes to the right one, even under pressure from the customer.
You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical department manager and defend it to their engineers, often in the same meeting
You're effective in ambiguous, under-documented, high-constraint environments

Fluent
Swedish and English are both required for this role.

Your title might have been Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or something else entirely. What matters is what you actually did: owning delivery in customer environments, end to end, with real stakes attached.

What You'll Gain

You'll build a combination that's hard to find elsewhere: production-level AI deployment experience in high-security environments, across multiple industries, with direct ownership of customer outcomes from start to finish.

Hands-on experience deploying AI in production-critical, high-security environments
Exposure to complex enterprise architectures across sectors and countries
Direct influence on product direction through real deployment feedback

What this job actually looks like

Up to 80% of your work happens in customer environments, alongside their technical teams primarly across Sweden with some cross-Nordics travel as projects require
. You learn their systems, integrate the platform, and own the outcome from the first sales conversation through go-live and beyond.

The environment spans Python, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, self-hosted LLMs, and Svelte. You won't use all of it on every project, but you need to move across the stack as the situation demands. You use AI tools well and quickly, but your value is the judgment behind them: knowing what to build, how to prioritize, and when to push back.

Your default is finding the path, not describing the obstacle. Sometimes that means telling a customer that what they're asking for is the wrong thing to build. Both are part of the job.

Why Intric

One of Europe's most trusted AI platforms for regulated organizations
Funded and growing: you're joining before the scale curve, not after
High ownership and decision-making authority from day one
A team that takes quality, security, and long-term trust seriously

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity
Occupational pension (tjänstepension) with fund choice and advisory meetings, plus sjukförsäkring, premiebefrielse, TFA, and TGL
25 days paid vacation
Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)

to design, build, and integrate AI-powered agents and business applications on Microsoft's low-code ecosystem. Alongside this, you'll develop Power Apps (both Canvas and Model-Driven), automate processes with Power Automate, and model data in Dataverse using Power Fx. You'll follow proper ALM practices using Git and Azure DevOps, and work within governance, security, DLP, and Entra ID frameworks to keep solutions compliant and secure. This is a great fit for someone who has already taken Copilot Studio solutions into production and wants to keep building agent-based platforms at scale.

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible

The impact you will have

Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.
