Location

Our Senior Cloud Architect
will be an integral part of our global Forward Deployment Engineering team. This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, Sweden, the Netherlands, and Israel and is available to Full-Time Employees. The job is also open to contractors in Eastern Europe or Portugal.

About DoiT

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage public cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state—from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence
, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Cloud Architect,
you will be part of our global Forward Deployed Engineering organization, working with rapidly growing companies in EMEA and around the world. This role sits within FDE Delivery
and focuses on our install base, product adoption and customer health.

You will:

Lead the design and implementation of production-grade ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS (with awareness of multi-cloud environments).
Act as a hands-on expert and trusted advisor for customers running AI/ML workloads at scale, from initial discovery through deployment and optimization.
Translate complex business problems into cloud architectures that are secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and observable.
Help evolve how DoiT uses AI/ML internally and with customers by turning one-off solutions into reusable patterns and “gravel roads” that influence the product roadmap.
You will focus more on install base health, product adoption, proactive engagements, and account-team work.

Responsibilities

Core – Deep Cloud Expertise

Be the trusted cloud engineer customers lean on for high‑impact technical optimization work across cost, reliability, security, and performance.

Design and help implement solutions that:

improve cost efficiency (rightsizing, reservations/commitments, storage optimization, etc.)
increase reliability and resilience (HA/DR architectures, SLO/SLA‑aware designs)
strengthen security posture (IAM, network segmentation, data protection, least‑privilege)
reduce operational toil (automation, self‑service, guardrails, policy enforcement)
Plan and deliver structured engagements such as Cloud Optimization Sessions, cost/efficiency/performance workshops, security posture or reliability reviews, and architecture deep dives / "well‑architected" style assessments.
Respond to Expert Inquiry / support requests that require deep cloud engineering expertise, ensuring high‑quality, well‑explained resolutions.
Bring domain depth in:
ML / GenAI – deploying and operating ML/GenAI workloads (training and inference), GPU utilization, scaling, and cost control; MLOPS and integrating workloads with monitoring, logging, and FinOps; safe and efficient use of managed AI services.

Builder – Product Feedback & Contribution

Turn one‑off field work into reusable assets that improve both customer outcomes and the product itself.

Convert one‑off customer solutions into Gravel Roads - reusable patterns such as playbooks, Terraform modules, CloudFlow templates, cloud diagrams, Composer Recipes -> DCI Insights, and internal /external documentation.
Provide structured feedback to the DoiT Product and Engineering teams on:
product gaps and friction points discovered in real‑world usage
new opportunities for automation and workload lenses within DCI
telemetry and tracking that would make future FDE work more efficient

Contribute directly to DCI where appropriate - from feature requests and feedback, to contributing code, to owning specific DCI features end‑to‑end.
Build agent skills, scripts, and internal tooling that codify your expertise and scale it across the team.
Contribute to internal enablement: share learnings via documentation, demos, office hours, or training sessions for other FDEs and Customer Success team members.

Account Team – Embedded Execution

Operate as an embedded technical partner inside the account team.

Work in the account team model alongside Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Account Managers (AMs) to deliver impactful outcomes.
Own the technical depth lane: technical deployment & integration, automation & platform adoption, signal‑based proactive engagement, and most importantly, repeatable Cloud Optimization solutions.
Partner with customers' engineers, architects, and FinOps teams to translate vague pain points into concrete technical optimization plans — and help them ship changes that stick and create continuous value.
Co‑deliver complex or multi‑domain engagements with peer FDEs (for example, infra + data + ML/GenAI), reviewing and refining designs, and engagement plans together.
Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both engineers and non‑technical stakeholders (FinOps, finance, leadership), and maintain clear documentation of architectures, decisions, and implemented changes so customers and fellow FDEs can sustain and build on your work.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement within the global FDE community through design reviews, internal forums, enablement sessions, and experimentation.

Product Expert – DoiT Cloud Intelligence™ (DCI)

Become an expert in DCI and use it hands‑on to drive concrete customer outcomes.

Master DoiT Cloud Intelligence™ products and services — including Cloud Analytics, DCI Insights, Cloud Composer, CloudFlow, DataHub, PerfectScale, and other Enterprise Platforms.
Use DCI hands‑on to:
Build and operationalize Cloud Analytics and Allocations to create dashboards and reports for customer engineering, finance, and leadership.
Use DCI Insights to identify and prioritize cost, risk, and reliability opportunities, and shepherd them through to closure.
Implement Cloud Composer queries, build recipes that result in hand-crafted insights across all customers' engineering use cases.
Build CloudFlow automations (e.g., anomaly routing, scheduled actions, guardrails, policy enforcement).
Use Built in Integrations such and utilize DataHub and other workload‑intelligence features to optimize key business and workload data inside DCI.

Help customers embed DCI into existing observability, CI/CD, and governance processes so it becomes trusted and indispensable in day‑to‑day cloud operations.

Qualifications

Experience

4+ years of experience architecting, deploying, and managing cloud-based AI/ML solutions, including production workloads.
Proven track record designing and operating large, distributed systems on AWS, selecting appropriate services and patterns to meet business and technical goals.

AWS & GenAI / ML Expertise

Advanced proficiency with AWS services relevant to AI/ML and GenAI.
Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock for deploying and scaling foundation models and Generative AI workloads.
Experience fine-tuning and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal AI using Amazon SageMaker (including JumpStart).
Strong prompt engineering skills and familiarity with rigorous model evaluation (quality, safety, performance).
Understanding of agentic capabilities and patterns for AI agents that autonomously perform tasks and integrate with existing systems.
Experience with Amazon Q Business and Amazon Q Developer (or similar tools) to accelerate insight generation and development workflows.

ML Pipelines, Data & MLOps

In-depth knowledge of Amazon SageMaker components such as Pipelines, Model Monitor, Data Wrangler, and SageMaker Clarify for bias detection and interpretability.
Proficiency integrating TensorFlow, PyTorch, and other ML frameworks with SageMaker for model development, fine-tuning, and deployment.
Experience with distributed training (multi-GPU or multi-node) and performance optimization for inference.
Strong data-engineering skills on AWS: Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Lake Formation, Redshift for AI/ML data pipelines.
Experience building end-to-end AI/ML workflows using services like AWS Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, and containerized deployments on Amazon EKS / AWS Fargate.

DevOps, MLOps, Governance & Security

Hands-on experience with CI/CD for AI/ML using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, SageMaker Pipelines, or similar.
Proficiency in monitoring and operating AI systems using Amazon CloudWatch and SageMaker Model Monitor.
Strong understanding of AI governance, security, and compliance on AWS, including IAM, KMS, and data privacy patterns.
Familiarity with AI ethics and bias detection/mitigation (e.g., using SageMaker Clarify or similar tools).

Multi-Cloud Awareness & Collaboration

Working knowledge of Google Cloud AI tools (e.g., Vertex AI, Cloud AutoML, BigQuery ML) sufficient to reason about multi-cloud architectures and integration points.
Proven ability to mentor peers, run enablement sessions, and collaborate across Sales, CS, and Product.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills across technical and business audiences; able to simplify complex ideas and influence decisions.
Natural ownership mentality: you escalate early, resolve fast, and own the outcome.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote-first, global environment.

Bonus Points

Education & Certifications

BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Additional data or AI certifications (e.g., AWS/GCP data certifications, reputable AI/ML programs such as Stanford, Coursera, Udacity, MIT, eCornell).

Expanded AI/ML & Dev Experience

Experience with modern RLHF, advanced fine-tuning techniques, and hybrid AI architectures.
Familiarity with Hugging Face or similar open-source ecosystems integrated with AWS.
Prior experience as a ML Engineer, Data Scientist, or AI-focused Architect in a consulting or SaaS environment.

Tooling & Process

Experience with JIRA or similar tools for tracking work across delivery and product-feedback cycles.
Exposure to Agile practices and frameworks commonly used for SaaS and cloud delivery.

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. You will be responsible for coding, testing, and maintaining software systems, while mentoring and building the test capabilities of the agile teams.

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the candidate will recognize areas for improvement across process, tooling, and ways of working, to identify quality approaches that can benefit your team and others.

What You Will Do

Developing and maintaining test automation solutions, creating test plans, and test strategies for testing multiple product features
Will consistently test the product and be an SME for at least one component of the product
Works across teams to capture gaps and improve existing test plans for product features
Clearly communicates with Product team and understands requirements and is able to formulate test plans and estimates
Confident to participate and provide inputs, and work on cross-product company initiatives
Automation first approach for development and continuous testing
Develops and maintains test automation frameworks
Accurately Monitor Test Automation results and log bugs against the product and the tests

Demonstrates application of new tools, approaches, and methods

Educated to degree level or master’s degree

Experienced in Automation testing using Pytest, Cypress, etc.
Working knowledge of REST APIs - Postman, SoapUI, JMeter, or other API testing frameworks

Experience working within CI/CD environments - Jenkins.

Experience in Cloud Technologies (preferably AWS, Azure) is a distinct advantage
Good Database Knowledge (SQL, Oracle Database)
Any knowledge or background with backups and storage domains
Working knowledge of Docker
Highly skilled and efficient in creating test strategies
Excellent critical thinking skills
AWS Accreditation a plus
Knowledge of Performance testing
Possesses excellent interpersonal skills including communication and assertiveness
Demonstrates a strong passion to learn
Knowledge of vulnerability and security concerns beneficial

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on.

If you’re looking for high-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.

Our Forma Design applications focus on outcome-based design, helping users weigh living quality (sun, daylight potential, noise, etc.), environmental impact (embodied and operational carbon), and profitability so they can find smarter, more sustainable solutions for their projects.

How we work

We work in small, autonomous teams that own their work and decide how best to build it. Engineers, product managers, and designers work side by side, collaborating across functions and time zones. We're an agentic-first organization, so working alongside AI tooling is part of how every team operates.

What you'll do

Over the summer, you'll work on a project that matters to your team, supported by experienced engineers. Your work is meant to ship and reach customers.

As a Software Engineering Intern, You'll

Contribute code to our in-market product, used by architects, urban planners, and real estate developers worldwide

Own a meaningful project from idea through to a working result, with guidance from your team

Gain hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies, from web-based 3D frameworks to large-scale systems and cloud computing

Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve customer problems
Take part in code reviews, design discussions, and the day-to-day work of an engineering team

We invest in your growth from day one. You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product managers, building your skills in a supportive environment. You'll also work directly with AI-powered tools as part of how we build software.

Beyond your project, you'll be part of the wider team, joining meetups, workshops, and hackathons, and getting a genuine feel for what a career in engineering at Autodesk looks like.

Who should apply

This internship is for students who want to spend their summer building software with a supportive team.

Currently studying computer science, software engineering, or a related field (preferred), ideally in your penultimate year, though we welcome strong students earlier in their studies too

Solid coding fundamentals from coursework, projects, or earlier internships
Curious, collaborative, and comfortable taking initiative and working independently
Comfortable breaking down problems and delivering practical solutions
Motivated by our mission to design better, more sustainable cities
Eligible to work in Norway

Practical details:
Paid internship

Full-time over summer 2027
On-site in our Oslo office
Applications close end of September 2026

We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For us to review your application, you must upload your CV, relevant diplomas/certificates, and academic transcripts in PDF format.

Even if you feel you don't check off all the items on the list, we still encourage you to apply. Kindly note that applications must include a cover letter and a CV to be considered.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Om WeCall AI

WeCall AI bygger AI-drevne telefonagenter for norske bedrifter. Agentene svarer telefonen 24/7, forstår hva kunden trenger, booker avtaler, henter informasjon og integreres direkte i kundens egne systemer. Vi har betalende kunder i drift, har hentet kapital, og vokser.

Rollen

Du blir vår første interne utvikler og får teknisk eierskap til produktet. Det betyr både å bygge selv og å sette retning. Konkret:
Eie og videreutvikle plattformen: samtaleflyt, prompt-design, RAG/kunnskapsbaser, funksjonskall mot eksterne systemer
Bygge integrasjoner mot kundenes fagsystemer (ordre, booking, CRM, saksbehandling), ofte API-er som ikke er laget for dette
Videreutvikle kundedashbordet (samtalevolum, transkripsjoner, innsikt i sanntid)
Ta ansvar for drift, kvalitet og sikkerhet: logging, evaluering av agentenes svar, latens, oppetid
Jobbe tett med daglig leder på produkt: du snakker med kunder, ser hva som feiler, og fikser det
Bygge teamet rundt deg etter hvert som vi vokser

Hvem vi ser etter

Erfaring som fullstack-utvikler, og du har hatt ansvar for noe som kjører i produksjon med ekte brukere
Du har bygget produkter oppå LLM-API-er. Du vet hva prompt-design, RAG, function calling og evaluering av output betyr i praksis, og hvor det går galt
Trygg på integrasjoner mot tredjeparts-API-er, inkludert de dårlig dokumenterte
Stort pluss: erfaring med sanntid: WebSockets, audio-streaming, telefoni, SIP, LiveKit eller lignende
Du liker å eie ting fra A til Å og trives bedre med ansvar enn med ferdige spesifikasjoner
Kommuniserer godt på norsk, også med folk som ikke er teknikere

Vi tilbyr

Fastlønn avhengig av erfaring, vi er åpne om rammen fra første samtale
Full teknisk frihet og direkte linje til ledelsen.
Kontor sentralt i Kristiansand (Dronningens gate 4) eller fullt remote i Norge
Et produkt som allerede har kunder, og et marked som er stort og umodent

Sted:
Kristiansand eller remote i Norge
Omfang:
Fulltid
Oppstart:
Etter avtale, helst innen utgangen av 2026

Send noen linjer om deg selv eller eventuelt CV, og lenke til noe du har bygget (GitHub, produkt, prosjekt) til magnus@wecall-ai.no. Merk e-posten «Tech Lead».

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101129

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform. Your contributions will have a direct impact on shaping our product and helping teams move faster across the organization. Our teams work on everything from complex 3D workflows in the browser to AI-driven analyses.

As a Principal Engineer, you’ll play a key role in setting technical direction and shaping how we build. You communicate complex ideas clearly and bring others along, helping teams make better decisions and move faster. You’ll work on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter,

more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.

About Us

We’re on a mission to help design better cities.

With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.

Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.

How We Work

We work in small, autonomous teams with a high degree of trust and ownership. We strongly believe in servant leadership and team accountability. In each team, software engineers work closely together with product managers and designers. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will use your technical expertise and strategic thinking to drive progress across team boundaries. You’ll contribute as a senior individual contributor, combining hands-on engineering with broad technical influence.

In This Role, You Will

Set technical direction and influence architecture across teams, with a focus on scalability, performance, and reliability
Contribute to the design and evolution of systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI-driven capabilities
Drive high-impact technical initiatives and help align engineering efforts with broader product and business goals
Navigate trade-offs between performance, cost, and user experience in complex workflows
Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver meaningful user outcomes
Share knowledge, mentor others, and help grow technical capability across the organization

Desired profile

Operates with a high degree of autonomy and clarity in ambiguous situations
Drives architectural and strategic decisions across squads or domains
Recognized as a domain expert or strong generalist across multiple technologies
Brings others along by mentoring, enabling, and fostering technical growth
Continuously identifies areas for improvement in how we work and delivers change
Collaborates across functions to align engineering with product and user outcomes
Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes at scale

Areas of expertise that might resonate with you

You get your energy from building the foundations other people rely on, pulling systems apart into simple, observable pieces, owning something in production long enough to feel responsible for it, and reaching for the boring, reliable option before building something new.
You're drawn to problems where the math is the hard part, geometry, simulation, optimization, and you like taking a model from "this is the theory" to something that runs reliably on real inputs and matches what users expect to see.
You start from the user and the problem, not the ticket. You are comfortable with a fuzzy brief and a blank repo, shipping fast to learn, and shaping what gets built as much as how it gets built.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Proven experience driving architectural or technical decisions beyond a single team
Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and seniority levels
Experience with Agentic AI

You might also bring

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Why join us

Work on real-world problems with measurable environmental impact
Shape technical direction at a platform level
Collaborate with experienced engineers across disciplines
Competitive compensation, pension, and benefits

We believe diverse teams build better products, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people can be themselves and do their best work. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement listed. Curiosity, empathy, and a growth mindset matter just as much to us.

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Help shape how cities are designed

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to grow and develop talent across our organization in our AI-powered architecture design platform. You will spend roughly 70% of your time on product development and 30% on people leadership, managing career growth, removing blockers, and developing individual contributors. You will be working with a group of engineering managers, focusing on the health and growth of our people.

As an Engineering Manager you will be the people leader for a group of individual contributors who work on different product teams. You will combine hands-on technical judgment with thoughtful people leadership. You will mentor engineers in their growth, set quality and technical standards, and remove blockers so your engineers can do their best work. You will work alongside your people on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Conduct regular one-on-ones, feedback cycles, and coaching conversations
Participate in hiring and onboarding of engineers. Ensure smooth integration into the organization and their product teams
Remove blockers and advocate for your engineers to ensure they have what they need to succeed
Work with product leads and peer managers to support team health and development

Hans-On engineering

Contribute by coding and being a member of the team
Partner with your engineers on technical problems and decisions
Model high standards for code quality, communication, and problem-solving
Work through technical trade-offs alongside your engineers, contributing your own perspective as a peer contributor

Operates with clarity in ambiguous situations and is comfortable handling competing priorities
Recognized as a skilled engineer who writes and ships code regularly
Brings others along through mentoring, enabling, and fostering growth
Experience managing individual contributors across multiple contexts or product areas
Collaborates effectively with peers, product leads, and across the organization
Comfortable developing engineers who work in different teams and on different projects

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Experience in an engineering manager, team lead, or similar people-leadership role
Genuine interest in developing people and creating environments where they grow
Comfort with matrix or dotted-line structures where you manage people who work across different teams
Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership
Strong communication skills, especially in one-on-one coaching and feedback conversations
Experience with Agentic AI

You might also bring

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Track record of mentoring and developing engineers into stronger contributors
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Develop engineers across the organization while staying technical. Roughly 70% of your time spent on hands-on product development

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our international development team.

We are a dynamic multidisciplinary group, passionate about creating solutions to advance adaptive radiotherapy for the benefit of cancer patients world-wide. Our passion is putting state-of-the-art software design and technology in service of advancing cancer treatment.

Domain Driven Design is the backbone of our design thinking, elements of the Microservices style drive the deployment. The Event Driven Architecture style and CQRS are means of achieving the right decoupling.

As a member of an agile team working on Varian's next generation treatment management system, you will participate in the full software development lifecycle from design and implementation to production deployment and operation support.

In addition, we offer ample opportunities to develop innovative solutions in the clinical domain.

We are looking for someone with strong development skills, passion for modelling and sustainable design and web development experience.

In addition, you are an open minded, adaptable thinker who will thrive in collaborative environments and value diverse perspectives.

We are developing a mission critical system, thus your commitment to safety and quality is a must.

As Senior Software Engineer, you will also be involved in the design of the software architecture, including defining interfaces, data flow, and integration strategies leveraging modern technology stacks.

You will collaborate with the Product Management and System Architecture teams to leverage emerging technologies, including Generative AI, to enhance the development cycle and enable modernization of the existing software.

Ethos Adaptive Therapy

What Will Set You Apart

Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and distributed system design.
Experience applying Generative AI to software development.
Experience in software architecture and the design of distributed software systems.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
A passion for innovation and continuous learning.

Your Role

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
In-depth knowledge of software engineering and experience using C#/.NET or another object-oriented language.
Experience in software development of distributed, service-oriented systems.
Web UI and cloud development experience, using Angular or similar framework.
Fluency in English language, both written and verbal.

Any Of The Following Is a Plus

Experience with virtualization and containerization.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with automation and scripting, such as PowerShell or Ansible.
Knowledge of current containerization and orchestration technologies in a Linux environment, including Kubernetes, Docker, and networking stacks.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards, such as DICOM and DICOM networking and safety-critical software development.

Who we are
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Ratkaisuarkkitehti vastaa liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin sopivien teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja määrittelystä Microsoft Power Platform-, Azure- ja tekoälyympäristöissä. Hän varmistaa, että ratkaisut muodostavat toimivan, turvallisen ja ylläpidettävän kokonaisuuden, joka tukee organisaation tavoitteita sekä nykyisiä että tulevia tarpeita.

Roolissa yhdistyvät tekninen osaaminen, kokonaisuuksien hahmottaminen ja kyky tehdä yhteistyötä niin liiketoiminnan kuin teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Ratkaisuarkkitehti toimii siltana liiketoiminnan tavoitteiden ja käytännön toteutuksen välillä.

Etsimme ratkaisuarkkitehtia, joka pystyy yhdistämään liiketoiminnan tavoitteet, teknologian mahdollisuudet ja toteutuksen käytännön vaatimukset toimivaksi kokonaisuudeksi. Henkilöllä on kokemusta laajojen sovellus- ja integraatioratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kyky ohjata kehitystä arkkitehtuurin näkökulmasta koko ratkaisun elinkaaren ajan.

Menestyt roolissa, jos hahmotat kokonaisuuksia nopeasti, osaat tehdä perusteltuja teknisiä valintoja ja pystyt viestimään ne selkeästi sekä kehittäjille että liiketoiminnan edustajille. Suunnitella liiketoiminnan tarpeita tukevia sovellus-, integraatio- ja tekoälyratkaisuja.

Ohjata kehitystiimejä teknisissä ratkaisuissa ja tukea toteutuksen onnistumista koko projektin ajan.
Määritellä sovelluskehityksen hallintamalleja, ympäristöstrategioita sekä käyttöönotto- ja ylläpitokäytäntöjä.
Arvioida ja suunnitella tekoälyn hyödyntämistä osana liiketoimintaprosesseja ja digitaalisia palveluja.
Kuvata ja esitellä ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja eri sidosryhmille ymmärrettävästi.

Kokemusta Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen ja pilvipalveluiden arkkitehtuurisuunnittelusta.
Ymmärrys sovelluskehityksen elinkaaren hallinnasta, DevOps-toimintatavoista ja ympäristöjen hallinnasta.

Kyky määritellä tietoturvaan, käyttöoikeuksiin, tietosuojaan ja hallintamalleihin liittyviä ratkaisuja.
Kokemusta tekoäly- ja automaatioratkaisujen hyödyntämisestä osana laajempia liiketoimintaratkaisuja.
Ymmärrys käyttäjäkeskeisestä suunnittelusta ja kyky huomioida loppukäyttäjän tarpeet ratkaisujen suunnittelussa.
Erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja fasilitointitaidot sekä kyky kommunikoida teknisiä ratkaisuja erilaisille kohderyhmille.
Käytännön kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja modernien kehitysvälineiden hyödyntämisestä.

jobs.title: Value Architect, Industry 4.0
jobs.description:
A senior industrial data and IT/OT expert who turns operational data into results, advising our key clients from strategy through delivery.

Do you enjoy working with industrial data and AI, where OT meets IT and data becomes operational results? Are you equally at home advising senior client stakeholders with a strategic vision and roadmap and, as lead architect, staying hands-on through the work that delivers it? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help industrial enterprises turn operational data into results, bridging OT and IT from the shop floor to the cloud, and moving from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect, Industry 4.0 in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert and the trusted advisor industrial clients lean on to turn operational data into results. This is primarily a client-facing role. You work with senior stakeholders on where unified industrial data and AI turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in uptime, quality, and decision speed, and which team should deliver them. You own the architecture across the IT and OT boundary and stay hands-on through delivery. A smaller part of the role helps the practice grow: you support presales when your expertise is needed, feed what you learn back into our industrial offering, and now and then share it through talks and writing. One morning you frame the business case with a VP of operations. That afternoon you review an edge-to-cloud architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with

Our work in this space turns industrial data into operational results. Most industrial enterprises want to scale AI but cannot, because fragmented OT and IT systems and inconsistent data quality leave them without a foundation to build on. We fix that first.

You take the lead on engagements like our Industrial Data & AI Kickstart and the platform and use-case work that grows out of it. You own them as the lead architect: facilitating the workshops, conducting a significant share of the analysis and design yourself, and bringing in specific experts, from IT/OT and cloud to integration and data and AI, where deeper specialism is needed.
This is operations-first work. It runs from the shop floor to the cloud, bridges OT and IT, and is grounded in real operational needs rather than slideware. You start here, sharpen the offering as you run it, and help shape what comes next.

What You Will Do

This is primarily a client-facing role.

Advise clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor.
Work with senior client stakeholders (heads of operations and manufacturing, plant and maintenance leaders, CDOs and CIOs) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Run the Kickstart.
Lead the discovery and design workshops, assess the as-is OT and IT landscape, and produce the edge-to-cloud target architecture, the governance and operating model, and the roadmap the client executes against.
Own the architecture.
Steer architecture and design decisions across the IT and OT boundary so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every integration yourself, but you stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the Kickstart. Stay hands-on through platform foundation and use-case pilots to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case into production.

Contribute to the offering and the practice
A smaller part of the role looks inward. You support presales when your expertise is needed, handle the hard technical objections, and help shape proposals and value cases. You turn what you learn on engagements into reusable patterns and proof points, and you share some of it through talks and writing. You mentor others and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so the practice grows beyond any one person.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in manufacturing operations management and industrial data with business acumen
(IT/OT or IIoT Architect, Industrial Data Architect, MES/MOM Lead, or similar), with ten or more years on the consulting or customer side.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of more than one industry or industry type we serve is required, so you can speak the customer’s language from day one. Experience in both process and discrete industries, such as metals, forest, energy, packaging, chemical, or machine building, is especially welcome.
A track record of growing trusted client relationships
and turning advice into delivered work, with real ownership of the outcome rather than the handover.
Consultative mindset
. You lead with the customer’s operational problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
Industrial platform familiarity
. Comfortable across the industrial stack, from shop floor to cloud: IT/OT integration, MES/MOM, process historians, edge and connectivity tooling, OPC UA and UNS architectures, data analytics over time-series data, and standards such as ISA-95/88. You are familiar with OT infrastructure, networking, and security, and with architecting containerized workloads at the edge. On the cloud side, you are comfortable with modern data stacks such as Azure IoT, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Applied AI.
Experience with machine learning solutions deployed in production (beyond PoC scope) for areas such as production, maintenance, quality, and warehouse optimization. GenAI solutions in production are a plus.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach shop floor engineers, enterprise architects, and operations leaders. German is an asset.
AI-first ways of working.
Comfortable using modern AI tools in your own work, with coding agents a plus. You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.

Why join us

Work where data meets the shop floor.
Real plants and real operations, from the Kickstart through to production, not perpetual pilots. You see the architecture you stand behind actually run.
A community, not a silo.
A multidisciplinary network behind you, from IT/OT, cloud, and integration architects to data and AI specialists, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you design.
Sell from strength.
Twenty-five years of industrial delivery, with experience in industrial digitalization dating back to 1987 and long-standing work with metals, energy, and forest clients. We are a Featured Microsoft Fabric Partner and one of the very few partners named in Microsoft’s Industrial AI Partner Guide.

Salary range:
5900-8800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product and on capabilities used by investment professionals to understand portfolios, performance and risk.

In your daily work you will, together with your team, understand and review customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, Dyalog APL and Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend components, APIs and services.

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping parts of our product for the cloud. We are not modernizing for the sake of fashion. We are doing it because our products are business critical, widely used and need to keep evolving in a careful way.

AI Is Part Of How We Work Every Day

We use AI every day and see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. We actively look for ways to integrate AI into our work whenever it creates real benefit for our customers, products, teams or engineers. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work, explore alternatives and build better software.

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team and individual.

We encourage personal development, curiosity and experimentation. Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements, giving you regular opportunities to explore new technologies, improve something important, or try out ideas that may benefit you, your team or the application.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We are looking for a developer who enjoys real product engineering: understanding the problem, discussing trade-offs, writing good software, ensuring quality and improving the system over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to help lead beyond writing code. You will contribute to design discussions, help the team make good technical decisions, improve maintainability and performance, and support the software you help build.

Designing, developing and maintaining backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET
Working with Dyalog APL and other technologies where they are part of the product
Contributing to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value
Improving performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience
Using CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work
Using AI every day as part of practical engineering work, including exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, generating prototypes, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks
Working with the team to discover where AI can create real value in our development process and where human engineering judgment should lead
Collaborating with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software solutions
Supporting the team in continuously improving both the product and the way we work

What We Expect From You

We expect you to know some of the following and be able to, and interested in, learning the rest:

C# and .NET development
Backend development and API design
Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications
Continuous integration and delivery
Automated testing and practical quality engineering
Working with relational databases, such as Oracle or similar
Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services
A willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL
Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and how it can improve daily development work

Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important than your ability to learn, collaborate, and handle responsibilities.

We value people who are good at several of the following and interested in improving the rest:

Leading your work and achieving results
Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
Working with others to leverage the abilities of everyone in the team
Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
Looking continuously for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Comparing technical quality with business value
Using modern tools, especially AI tools, every day where they help us build better software and become better engineers
Contributing to an inclusive, trust-based and collaborative engineering culture

How We Work

We believe good software engineering is a team activity. Quality is not something handed over at the end. It is built into the way we discuss requirements, design solutions, write code, test, review, deploy and learn from production feedback.

We also believe senior engineers should have room to think. We do not expect you to chase every trend. We expect you to apply sound engineering judgment, use modern practices where they help, and help us evolve a large and widely used product in a way that is sustainable for clients, users and engineers.

AI is one of the modern practices we take seriously. We do not view AI as a separate area of engineering. We view it as another tool in the engineering toolbox. Just as we continuously adopted better testing, automation and cloud technologies, we expect AI to become a natural part of how we design, build, document, test, maintain and improve software.

Benefits

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age or any non-professional information from your application. If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you.

Are you a highly skilled architect who can turn complex commercial, digital, data and artificial intelligence choices into clear direction? Join Lundbeck as Commercial Domain Architect and help shape our commercial digital ecosystem.

In this role, you will be the design authority for the commercial digital domain across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled workflows. You will help create a coherent ecosystem that can scale across markets while balancing global consistency, local relevance, speed, flexibility and long-term sustainability.

Your new role

As Commercial Domain Architect, you will own and evolve the target architecture for Lundbeck’s commercial digital domain, translating commercial priorities into clear architectural direction across platforms, integrations, data and future capabilities.

A key part of your role will be navigating complex trade-offs where there is rarely one perfect answer — for example global standardisation versus local flexibility, platform-native versus modular approaches, and speed of delivery versus long-term scalability.

You will work closely with the Head of Architecture & Design, solution architects, commercial stakeholders, colleagues across data, artificial intelligence, security and operations, and external partners. You will be a trusted sparring partner for the solution architects, helping them navigate design choices, challenge assumptions and keep solutions aligned with the broader commercial target architecture.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Shape the commercial architecture

Own and evolve the target architecture across customer relationship management, customer engagement, omnichannel, content, analytics, commercial data and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities.
Define how customer, account, engagement, content, consent, insight and performance data connect across the commercial ecosystem.
Define platform boundaries, integration patterns and solution principles that enable interoperability, reuse and future flexibility across the organisation.

Provide strategic design authority

Act as the architectural design authority for the commercial domain and assess solution fit within agreed enterprise principles and guardrails.
Provide clear recommendations on strategic trade-offs and make the rationale understandable to both senior stakeholders and technical teams.
Identify and challenge designs that could create unnecessary duplication, technical debt, weak interoperability, vendor dependency or constraints on future scalability and innovation.

Enable data and artificial intelligence

Ensure the commercial architecture supports trusted, well-governed and artificial intelligence-ready data and insights.
Shape the architectural foundation for scalable artificial intelligence workflows and future artificial intelligence-enabled customer engagement.
Connect commercial architecture with wider enterprise capabilities across data, artificial intelligence, integration, security and operations.

Guide solutions from architecture to delivery

Act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects and guide external partners so detailed designs remain aligned with the commercial target architecture and agreed design principles.
Challenge technology and implementation partners on data models, integration, extensibility, compliance, scalability, vendor dependency and long-term cost.
Provide architectural recommendations and risk assessments that inform platform, vendor, investment and roadmap decisions.

Your future team

You will join the Architecture & Design team within Commercial Digital Enablement, part of Lundbeck’s Enterprise Digital Enablement organisation. The team connects commercial priorities with enterprise architecture and solution design, helping Lundbeck develop digital capabilities that can be reused and scaled across markets.

You will report to the Head of Architecture & Design. As Commercial Domain Architect, you will provide professional architecture authority for the commercial domain and act as a senior sparring partner for solution architects, the Delivery Lead and stakeholders across Commercial, Data, Artificial Intelligence, Security and Operations.

The position has no direct people-management responsibility, but you will have significant professional influence through your role as the architectural authority for the commercial digital domain.

The role is based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Given the collaborative and leadership nature of the role, frequent in-office presence is required.

What You Bring To The Team

We are looking for a highly talented architect who combines strong technical judgement with commercial understanding, pragmatic decision-making and excellent communication skills. You bring:

8+ years of experience in domain architecture, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or senior platform roles.
Strong understanding of commercial capabilities within life sciences, including customer relationship management, customer engagement, customer and account data, and analytics.
Experience shaping target architectures and designing scalable digital ecosystems across multiple markets or business units.
Strong understanding of data, artificial intelligence, integration, platform architecture and governance.
Experience assessing platform and ecosystem choices and challenging technology vendors and implementation partners.
The ability to assess complex architectural trade-offs and advise senior stakeholders in practical business language.
A collaborative working style, with the ability to build trust and create alignment across business, digital, data, artificial intelligence and technology teams.
The confidence to act as a constructive sparring partner for solution architects, helping translate architectural principles into practical solution design.
A strong enterprise mindset, with the ability to balance local requirements with scalability, interoperability and long-term sustainability.

Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further in addressing the significant unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with exciting challenges and development opportunities, balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
About Apylon and the opportunity

Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.
Hospitals and payers move billions of euros through fragmented, manual workflows shaped by clinical data, payer rules, contracts, and local coding systems. We believe this is a data, machine-learning, and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

We are live with leading private hospitals and expanding quickly. Every hospital presents a different challenge: EHR systems are configured differently, national coding rules vary, and contracts describe the same clinical event in different terms. Your job is to help us turn that complexity into a system that learns: each new integration should make the next one faster, safer, and less expensive.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe. You’ll join the first small engineering team, with massive ownership over both what we build and how we build it.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

Own EHR integrations end to end: APIs, schemas, undocumented behaviour, operational failure modes, and vendor changes.
Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.
Design the canonical data model that connects heterogeneous EHR data, reimbursement systems, national coding standards, and hospital-specific conventions.
Build reliable inputs for our billing agents, including the constraints, validation, and evaluation systems that make model-assisted decisions safe to use in production.
Work directly with hospital IT teams and EHR vendors: technical discovery, implementation, joint debugging, and onboarding.
Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work: design, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration from real-world data.

Who you are

3+ years building and operating production systems in complex, messy domains. We care more about demonstrated judgment and ownership than an exact number of years.
Experience using LLMs as production components—not just developer tools. You understand when to use models, when deterministic systems are better, how to constrain outputs, and how to evaluate reliability.
Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.
Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.
Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.
Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
A practical, hands-on approach: equally comfortable designing an integration architecture and writing a quick script to answer an urgent question.

This role may be a strong fit if

You enjoy reverse-engineering systems you do not control, finding structure in messy real-world data, and turning one-off discoveries into reusable software. You are comfortable being the engineer in the room with customers and partners.

What this role is not

Consulting or bespoke delivery work. Each integration must improve the product and reduce the marginal cost of the next.
A role insulated from customers or operational reality.
Pure platform engineering or pure integration work: the value comes from doing both.
A role where incorrect mappings are merely technical defects. In this domain, they can produce incorrect invoices.

Bonus points

Experience with healthcare interoperability or coding standards, including HL7v2, FHIR, or national messaging and reimbursement standards.
Experience building and operating third-party integrations at scale.
Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.
Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company.
Working proficiency in Danish, or German.

Our tech stack

Python · Django · React · PostgreSQL · AWS · K8s · Terraform · Bedrock
We’re pragmatic. You’ll have a big say in how it evolves.

What Apylon offers

The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.
Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).
25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.
Lunch on us during workdays at the office.
Regular off-sites and social events. We like building together, not just working together.
Travel within the EU roughly monthly. Onboarding a hospital, working through an integration with a vendor’s engineers, or spending time on-site to understand how the data is actually produced. If travelling to a hospital basement to figure out why an export is malformed sounds like a bad week, this isn’t your role.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code, powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue systems.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About The Role

Wiley is looking for a strong Solution Architect to join our ReX Review & Screening team in Iași, Romania. Research Exchange (ReX) is Wiley's publishing platform, built from components such as Review, Screening, and Commissions. As a Solution Architect, you will provide a holistic view of, and take ownership of, its infrastructure and supporting technologies, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and strategic direction for the long term in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective way. You'll partner closely with senior leaders, engineering and delivery teams, product managers, and development teams across these components to keep roadmaps aligned and guide well-considered technology decisions, all while remaining pragmatic.

Responsibilities

Provide a holistic view of, and ownership over, the platform's core and supporting technologies, building consensus on its future technical direction.
Make high-level technical decisions that influence all development teams, defining and communicating architectural solutions through code, where appropriate.
Understand the business context and vision for ReX, partnering with product teams to propose solutions that align with our direction.
Guide a cohesive technical direction across ReX's core components, helping each development team make well-aligned architectural choices as the platform evolves.
Lead scoping, architecture, and design across cloud and on-premises technologies, and drive multi-year architecture roadmaps.
Develop solutions using a cloud-first approach on AWS; establish strategies for secure identity, authentication, and authorization architectures; and lead security projects from conception through implementation.
Evaluate integration requirements for business solutions, ensuring adherence to architecture standards and information security policies.
Educate, support, and mentor development teams through training and hands-on collaboration, focusing on building the teams' own capabilities rather than creating dependency on you.
Continuously improve technical processes and practices, and implement quality assurance guidelines for testing, code quality, and deployment.
Stay ahead of industry trends, contribute to technology strategy and roadmaps, and maintain documentation of architectural decisions and standards.
Be part of the wider Research Architecture Group, contributing to pan-Wiley architecture policies, and conduct periodic skills gap analyses and training.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Degree in Computer Science or a related field (MSc preferred), or equivalent demonstrated experience; a minimum of 12 years in the software industry, including several years in an architecture or technical leadership capacity.
Proven track record in software and systems architecture and event-driven microservices, with deep expertise in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem and cloud-native technologies on AWS.

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise across our stack (Node.js, TypeScript, Express, React, and GraphQL), with a proven track record of architecting event-driven, service-based systems.
Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) running on AWS, as well as CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code practices.
Strong understanding of cloud delivery models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and observability and monitoring practices for distributed, service-based architectures.

Nice to Have

Experience with Agile and Lean methodologies; a strong grasp of clean code principles, continuous delivery, and managing technical debt.
Familiarity with GraphQL schema design and message/event-based integration patterns; AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect) is a plus.

Skills & Behaviors

Strong strategic planning, decision-making, and organizational skills; self-motivated, accountable, and able to influence and drive change across teams.
An analytical, flexible, and proactive problem-solver, comfortable managing both short-term deliverables and long-term goals.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership; works well independently and collaboratively at all levels.
An advanced level of English is required.

For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are looking for a Middle-Senior Backend Developer / Support Engineer to provide L2/L3 engineering support for SAP PowerDesigner. You will investigate complex customer issues, debug and maintain backend components, develop and validate hotfixes, perform root-cause analysis, and contribute targeted product improvements in a long-term enterprise support environment.

You will work in an English-speaking, distributed product-support organization serving SAP stakeholders and enterprise customers. The role combines hands-on backend development with operational support: incident ownership, customer-focused investigation, maintenance engineering, and continuous improvement. Collaboration will span development, support leadership, architecture, and service delivery.

What You'll Be Doing

Analyze and resolve L2/L3 product incidents
Reproduce issues and perform structured root-cause analysis
Debug C#/.NET and C/C++ components
Develop, test, and validate hotfixes and maintenance changes
Investigate customer-reported defects and performance issues
Document findings, fixes, and reusable troubleshooting guidance
Contribute focused feature and product-quality improvements

What You'll Bring Along

BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
5-7 years of software development experience
Strong hands-on C# and .NET development skills
Practical C or C++ development and debugging experience
Solid SQL and relational database knowledge
Experience with SAP PowerDesigner
Comfortable owning technical investigations end to end
PowerShell or VBScript scripting skills
Balances code quality with timely incident resolution
Familiarity with data-modelling tools and concepts
Communicates clearly with customers and distributed teams
Enterprise software or product-support experience
Works effectively as an individual contributor
Experience supporting long-lived desktop or backend products
Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Good written and spoken English communication skills
