jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst with .NET Background
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.

This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.

What You'll Be Doing

Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts
Support system integration analysis across applications, APIs, databases and external platforms
Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What You'll Bring Along

Bachelor’s degree in Informatics or similar field of study, or equivalent working experience
Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies
Experience with SQL Server, data modelling, database design concepts and data interfaces
Good understanding of REST APIs, application integrations and system data flows
Proven experience performing technical analysis, impact analysis and application reverse engineering
Strong experience with requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications
Experience documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, technical workflows and data mappings
Ability to facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams
Advanced knowledge of Agile / Scrum methodology
Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Confluence, Visio / Draw.io and SQL Server Management Studio
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills
Well-structured and organised working methodology
Excellent English verbal and written skills

jobs.title: .NET Developer Azure (Freelance kan)
jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor deze functie zoeken we een medior .NET-ontwikkelaar met een brede kennis van zowel klassieke als moderne technologieën. Je versterkt een productteam dat instaat voor de ontwikkeling, ondersteuning en verdere uitbouw van digitale toepassingen voor eindgebruikers.

Je werkt mee aan nieuwe functionele uitbreidingen, maar ook aan het onderhoud en de optimalisatie van bestaande webapplicaties. Samen met je collega’s neem je end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid op voor het realiseren van klantwaarde. Daarbij combineer je analyse, ontwerp, ontwikkeling, testing en ondersteuning binnen een Agile werkomgeving. De opdracht bestaat gemiddeld uit ongeveer twee derde projectwerk en één derde onderhoud en incidentopvolging.

Analyse en ontwerp

Je werkt mee aan functionele analyses en vertaalt businessvereisten naar technische oplossingen.
Je stelt technische ontwerpen op voor nieuwe functionaliteiten.
Je beoordeelt de technische haalbaarheid van nieuwe vragen en wijzigingsverzoeken.
Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere verbetering van applicatiearchitectuur en codekwaliteit.

Ontwikkeling en ondersteuning

Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en optimaliseert webapplicaties.
Je ondersteunt bestaande toepassingen binnen projectwerking, onderhoud en incidentbeheer.
Je realiseert uitbreidingen volgens functionele en technische vereisten.
Je onderzoekt incidenten en technische problemen en werkt duurzame oplossingen uit binnen de afgesproken servicelevels.
Je ondersteunt releaseactiviteiten en helpt mee aan een gecontroleerde uitrol van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

Kwaliteit en testing

Je bouwt kwalitatieve, performante en onderhoudbare software.
Je stelt unit tests op en voert ze uit.
Je ondersteunt integratie-, systeem- en acceptatietesten.
Je past ontwikkelrichtlijnen, best practices en IT-standaarden consequent toe.
Je documenteert analyses, ontwikkelingen en technische oplossingen zorgvuldig.

Samenwerking en werking

Je werkt nauw samen met product owner, analisten, ontwikkelaars, testers en andere stakeholders.
Je neemt actief deel aan Agile ceremonies zoals sprintplanning, refinements, reviews en retrospectives.
Je draagt bij aan kennisdeling binnen het team.

Change- en releasemanagement

Je past change- en releaseprocessen nauwgezet toe.
Je ondersteunt de voorbereiding, uitvoering en opvolging van releases.
Je bewaakt kwaliteit, risico’s en stabiliteit bij wijzigingen in productieomgevingen.

Jouw profiel

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met de ontwikkeling van .NET-gebaseerde toepassingen.
Je beschikt over uitgebreide kennis van en ervaring met .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET en Entity Framework.
Je hebt ervaring met federated authentication, waaronder SAML en OAuth.
Je hebt ervaring met Azure en met diensten zoals Azure API Management, Azure App Services, Azure Data Factory en Azure Service Fabric.
Je bent vertrouwd met webontwikkeling en courante front-end technologieën en frameworks, waaronder JavaScript en Angular 2 of hoger.
Je hebt ervaring met webservices zoals WCF, SOAP, Web API en REST.
Je kan werken met relationele databases, zoals Oracle en SQL.
Je hebt ervaring met unit testing.
Je bent vertrouwd met een Agile ontwikkelingsmethodiek.
Je voelt je thuis in een procesgestuurde organisatie en hebt voeling met ITIL-proceswerking.
Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen.
Je werkt zelfstandig, gestructureerd en nauwkeurig, met een proactieve en resultaatgerichte ingesteldheid.
Je communiceert vlot, werkt graag samen en draagt actief bij aan een positieve teamdynamiek.
Je bent leergierig en bereid om nieuwe technologieën en domeinkennis verder op te bouwen.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Desktop/SDK)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages
to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

The role:

You will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining and evolving the sync SDK powering Proton Drive's desktop applications. This includes not only building the application internals (managing and syncing local and remote state, performing cryptographic operations, etc) but also helping us to build resilient, scalable applications (graceful degradation; log and metrics streams free of personally identifiable information). You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, but with a strong focus on the internals shared amongst our desktop applications, including Gitlab configuration, deployments, monitoring and alerting, and operational incident response. While this position is not a "full-stack" position, you will be expected to collaborate with backend engineers to drive any necessary changes and/or new features needed for the core of our desktop experience.

What you will do:

Be part of a small team working to bring a "privacy by default" solution to our Drive clients on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Develop applications that delight a wide range of users, from layperson to technical, and gives confidence that their online privacy is in good hands - while getting the complexity of end-to-end encryption out of the way.
Invest in test automation to improve the team's productivity and software delivery cadence.
Think critically on how to divide problems into iterations of simpler, composable solutions. Re-evaluate the minimum scope as necessary to meet objectives on-time.
Insist on high standards for application monitoring and alerting, in order to ensure a smooth customer experience at all times.

We are looking for:

Strong experience in .NET development
Strong experience with concurrent multi-threaded programming
Optional experience building and maintaining desktop applications
Working knowledge of file systems
Working knowledge of Git
Bachelor's or master’s degree in a relevant field of study
Experience with owning and maintaining large software components
Experience with gradual rollouts and metrics/monitoring/alerting frameworks

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office.
Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.

You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About The Team

We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Examples of work

The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.
Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.
Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.
Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.

Responsibilities

Identify significant product opportunities and systemic engineering problems; set technical direction that balances near-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.
Prove approaches through prototypes, critical implementation, testing, and difficult debugging, using hands-on work to guide architectural decisions.
Lead cross-team delivery across Microsoft and GitHub, resolving architectural disagreements, clarifying ownership and API boundaries, and enabling teams to deliver independently.
Own outcomes beyond release, using adoption, quality signals, evaluations, experiments, and user feedback to guide investment and adjust course.
Improve engineering effectiveness across teams through testing strategies, performance work, shared design patterns, and tools for rapid, reliable experimentation.
Lead technical discussions in the open, investigate community-reported issues, and work directly with developers and extension authors to shape designs.
Mentor experienced engineers and technical leaders, helping them develop judgment and take ownership without making yourself a bottleneck.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams, including setting direction, building alignment, and delivering substantial initiatives without relying on reporting-line authority.
Solid hands-on coding and design skills, with the ability to become productive in large TypeScript and Rust codebases.
Experience designing shared platforms, APIs, or large application architectures, with sound judgment about extensibility, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.
Solid product judgment, including identifying opportunities, setting priorities amid ambiguity, and turning technical decisions into practical designs and measurable improvements for users.
A track record of mentoring experienced engineers and improving the effectiveness of teams beyond your immediate area.
Clear communication skills, including explaining complex technical decisions and navigating tradeoffs with engineering and product partners.

Preferred Qualifications

We welcome a range of product backgrounds; these are helpful experiences, not a checklist. Previous work on developer tools, open-source projects, or AI products is not required.

Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript and Rust.
Experience evolving interactive products with attention to usability and accessibility.
Experience guiding cross-platform architecture, performance improvements, or major migrations in a large application.
Experience establishing experimentation and feedback practices that connect engineering decisions to user outcomes.
Practical familiarity with AI coding tools and sound judgment about where they help, where they fall short, and how they change development workflows.
Experience providing technical leadership on AI-powered products, open-source projects, or extensible applications.

Somos Xeridia
, una empresa tecnológica española fundada en 2003, con sede corporativa en León y oficinas en Valladolid, Madrid, y Londres. Hemos participado en más de 500 proyectos para organizaciones líderes en banca, seguros, telecomunicaciones, energía y salud a nivel internacional.
Lo que nos define no son las cifras: es el equipo
. Somos más de 140 personas con pasión por el software de alta complejidad técnica, por aprender continuamente y por trabajar en proyectos con impacto real. Trabajamos con marcos de trabajo ágiles e integramos la IA
como herramienta cotidiana, con un enfoque ético y responsable. Contamos con el respaldo tecnológico de Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Atlassian y OutSystems
, y con 6 certificaciones ISO que avalan nuestros procesos.

No es casualidad: llevamos 23 años demostrando que desde aquí se puede trabajar para el mundo.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos Senior .NET Engineer
para trabajar en un entorno en continua mejora y evolución tecnológica en León o Valladolid.

Tu día a día se desarrollará en un contexto de vanguardia:

Spec-Driven Development (SDD):
antes de escribir código, definimos lo que el sistema debe hacer. En este rol elaborarás especificaciones detalladas (requisitos funcionales, arquitectura y comportamiento esperado) antes de codificar.
Desarrollo asistido por IA:
uso habitual de Visual Studio / VS Code con Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor o similares en todo el ciclo, con criterio para evaluar lo que generan.
IA agéntica y Claude Skills:
usarás Claude Skills y MCP en el ciclo de desarrollo.
DevOps y CI/CD:
pipelines automatizados (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) y mejora constante del ciclo de entrega.
Stack tecnológico:
el lenguaje es lo de menos… En este proyecto: C#, .NET (8 o superior), ASP.NET Core (Web API), Entity Framework Core, SQL Server y Microsoft Azure, además de la evolución de aplicaciones en .NET Framework.
Calidad:
responsable de la calidad de tu código y referencia para el equipo: pruebas unitarias, de integración y funcionales (xUnit/NUnit), Clean Code, SOLID y code reviews.
Infraestructura como código:
Terraform, Ansible o Bicep.

¿Qué perfil necesitamos?

Formación:
Grado en Ingeniería Informática o titulación similar.
Experiencia:
al menos 3 años desarrollando software con tecnologías .NET en proyectos reales, con capacidad para afrontar retos complejos de forma autónoma.
Skills técnicos:
C# y .NET moderno, APIs REST con ASP.NET Core, EF Core y SQL; patrones de diseño, POO, Clean Code y SOLID.
SDD:
capacidad para elaborar especificaciones detalladas antes de codificar.
Desarrollo asistido por IA:
uso habitual y con criterio de modelos de lenguaje, evaluando críticamente el código generado.
IA agéntica y Claude Skills:
conocimiento práctico de Skills y MCP.
Mentalidad ágil:
experiencia en Scrum/Kanban.

¿Qué habilidades adicionales pueden sumar valor a tu perfil?

Blazor o frameworks front-end (Angular, React).
Microservicios, mensajería (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ) y contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes).
Migración de .NET Framework (incluido VB.NET) a .NET moderno.
Certificaciones Microsoft (p. ej., Azure Developer Associate).
Capacidad para desenvolverte con soltura en inglés, abriendo puertas a proyectos y colaboraciones internacionales.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

🚀 Proyectos de alta complejidad técnica:
trabajamos en problemas de alta complejidad técnica para clientes muy exigentes. No es para todo el mundo, y eso también es parte de lo que nos define.
🤝 El equipo, primero:
el nivel técnico de las personas con las que trabajarás es, probablemente, lo primero que nota quien llega. Aprenderás de tus compañeros/as porque saben más que tú en algo, y ellos aprenderán de ti en otra cosa. Esa densidad técnica no es casual.
💡 Siempre a la última, antes que el resto:
no llegamos a las tecnologías cuando ya son mainstream. Las adoptamos, las debatimos y las aplicamos en proyectos reales antes que la mayoría. Si tienes curiosidad técnica, aquí siempre hay algo nuevo en lo que crecer.
⚡ Sin jerarquías, sin intermediarios:
somos una empresa sin jerarquías. Las decisiones se toman con las personas adecuadas, de forma directa y sin intermediarios.
🧠 IA como ventaja, no como moda:
incorporamos inteligencia artificial de forma práctica en nuestros proyectos y en nuestra forma de trabajar. Tendrás acceso a herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude, formación real sobre cómo usarlas con criterio y la posibilidad de contribuir a proyectos donde la IA no es un extra, sino parte del núcleo.
🕐 Flexibilidad que se cumple:
horario flexible y modelo híbrido. Jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año, más julio y agosto completos. 22 días de vacaciones, y el 24 y el 31 de diciembre libres, siempre.
💰 Retribución competitiva:
salario alineado con el mercado y revisado según tu evolución real. Retribución flexible en restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación para que optimices lo que más te conviene.
🩺 Salud y bienestar:
seguro médico y dental, plan corporate en centros deportivos y torneos internos para los que quieran competir o simplemente desconectar.
🎁 Y los detalles también importan:
Welcome pack, cesta de Navidad, eventos de equipo y portal de descuentos exclusivo.

Nuestro compromiso:
tendrás respuesta en menos de una semana, independientemente del resultado.

Full-time contract in a growing, international scale-up

Signicat is a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider, supporting over 170 data sources for seamless identity verification. Trusted by governments, financial institutions, and businesses worldwide. Such as General Financing, Compensa Life, Telia, Rimi, Volvo, and many more.

Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale.

Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world.

Since 2007, Signicat has been steadily growing organically and through strategic acquisitions, which led us to become a pioneering Pan-European Digital Identity Service Provider (DISP). We support 170+ data sources to identify businesses and individuals – from national eIDs, ID-document scanning, and biometric verification to data sources for AML and KYC checks, all accessible through a single integration point.

The Role

As a hands-on Engineering Manager, you will combine Java programming with engineering and technical leadership for one of our teams working in the domain of Identity Proofing. You will be responsible for growing and supporting the team, driving delivery, prioritizing the roadmap and backlog together with the Product Owner and other stakeholders, and balancing new capabilities with reliability, operational excellence, and technical debt.

The team is currently working on Signicat's next-generation offering for Identity Proofing by orchestrating several means available in the Signicat portfolio, such as NFC chip reading and live video identifications, in order to satisfy the highest compliance requirements in the market for financial services and similar.

How You'll Make An Impact

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive the evolution of Signicat's Identity Proofing platform, ensuring it remains secure, scalable, reliable, and ready for future growth.
Collaborate closely with architects, engineering teams, and stakeholders across the company to deliver capabilities that satisfy ever-changing market needs.

You are an experienced engineering leader who enjoys building high-performing teams as much as building great technology.

You thrive at the intersection of engineering and product, translating business needs into technical priorities and delivery plans.

Your Tech, Your Way: Choose the laptop and tech gear that you are most comfortable and productive with.
A Truly International Team: Join a diverse and welcoming community with active Employee Resource Groups, including Women in Signicat and our LGBTQ+ group.

We're a dynamic community of passionate professionals dedicated to digital identity solutions.

High priority customer technical leadership
Docker field technical leadership

High priority customer technical leadership

Work with Docker’s most important customers and cross functional Docker teams to accelerate the customer’s container and AI journeys, focusing on developer workflows

Docker field technical leadership (regional/area of responsibility)

Coordinate with Field CTO and other Solutions Architects to prioritize/contextualize/correlate field requests into a cohesive set of prioritized requests to the product/engineering teams.

Give input on internal technical enablement and customer enablement needs, and review enablement content

Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solution Architect in complex enterprise environments.
Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in managing customer relationships at the technical and business level.

Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies strongly preferred.
Development, Agentic AI dev, Software Development Lifecycle and/or Software Supply Chain Security experience strongly preferred.

First 30 days

Actively engage with senior stakeholders, and manage relationships with clients

Engineering is a critical function at Nitro, developing the products and services at the heart and soul of our business today, and helping us realize our vision of smarter documents in the future. Hybrid Work

Minimum of 5 years of experience building applications using a modern stack built with .NET

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100960

Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron-based desktop platform. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will develop and maintain test automation, CI/CD pipelines, desktop packaging, and release validation. You will work with experienced engineers to improve developer feedback, automate repeatable release processes, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure that customer releases are reliable and well tested. This is a hybrid role based in our Sheffield office.

Responsibilities

Test automation - approximately 35%: Develop and maintain automated functional, integration, end-to-end, installer, upgrade, and regression tests. Add automated coverage for new features and improve existing tests as the product evolves
CI/CD and build automation - approximately 30%: Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows
Release qualification and automation - approximately 20%: Help automate Windows desktop packaging, code signing, publishing, installation validation, upgrade testing, and release-candidate qualification
Troubleshooting and quality improvement - approximately 15%: Investigate build, test, installer, and application failures. Work with software engineers to identify root causes, reproduce issues, and implement or automate solutions
Review product requirements and user stories to understand test scope, identify quality risks, and contribute to test plans
Execute functional, integration, regression, and other forms of testing when automation is not yet available or when exploratory validation is appropriate.
Build and maintain reusable test utilities, test data, and automation components
Help create automated Windows test environments using virtual machines or other reproducible infrastructure
Participate in release-readiness activities, bug bashes, defect triage, and risk assessment
Monitor test and pipeline results, report failures clearly, and help distinguish product defects from test or infrastructure issues
Improve flaky tests and unreliable pipeline stages to increase the quality of developer feedback
Document build, test, and release procedures so they can be understood and maintained by the broader engineering team
Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Software development or test automation experience using a language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, C#, Java, or similar
Experience developing automated tests for software applications
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar
Understanding of source control systems such as Git and common software development workflows
Ability to troubleshoot common software, test automation, build, and environment problems
Understanding of software testing practices including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers and other technical team members
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Windows desktop applications
Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application-startup scenarios
Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments
Familiarity with enterprise Windows environments, device-management systems, corporate proxies, or restricted-user configurations
Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

The Ideal Candidate

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems, learning unfamiliar tools, asking questions when needed, and working with more experienced engineers on complex issues. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve the reliability of the team's development and release processes.

You also value the benefits of hybrid collaboration and are comfortable working regularly from Autodesk's Sheffield office while partnering with distributed teams across the company.

We are building a new desktop platform that enables Autodesk's web-based products to deliver richer, higher-performance experiences on Windows. Forma is the first product adopting the platform, with the longer-term goal of creating reusable desktop capabilities for additional Autodesk products.

You will join a new cross-functional platform team working across desktop application engineering, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, and software release.

This is a hybrid working position based out of Autodesk's Sheffield office.
You will collaborate both in person with colleagues in Sheffield and remotely with engineering and partner teams across Autodesk.

Your role:
Engineer - IT Manufacturing Execution

As an Engineer at Elanco, you will be a key technical contributor to the digital heart of our production facilities. You will specialize in implementing and supporting our Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). This hands-on role is the critical bridge between our physical manufacturing processes and the digital systems that control and document them, ensuring our operations are efficient, compliant, and reliable.

This includes four strategic priorities:

Pipeline Acceleration: Optimize the search and approval of high impact medicines with a focus on speed, cost and precision.
Manufacturing Excellence: Improve the efficiency, quality and consistency of core manufacturing processes, specifically execution and equipment effectiveness.
Sales Effectiveness: Simplify the process to find, trust and consume relevant customer insights that drive sales growth and improved engagement.
Productivity: Expand operating margin through efficiency by systematically reducing our operating expenses across the company, improving profitability.

Your Responsibilities:

System Design and Configuration: Contribute to the design and be responsible for the configuration and implementation of MES solutions. This includes building and modifying electronic batch records (EBRs), system workflows, and configuring equipment integration based on defined requirements.
Process Optimization: Collaborate with operations and quality teams to analyze manufacturing and laboratory workflows. You will use MES capabilities to help implement process improvements, reduce production cycle times, and enhance data integrity at the shop-floor level.
System Management and Support: Provide frontline technical support for MES platforms. You will act as a key technical resource to troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring high availability for our manufacturing and lab teams.
Integration: Assist with the integration between MES and other critical systems, such as our ERP (SAP), and shop-floor equipment (PLCs/SCADA), ensuring a reliable flow of data.
Validation and Compliance: Execute validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) for MES enhancements and new implementations. You will be responsible for generating validation documentation and ensuring systems are maintained in a validated state, compliant with GxP and data integrity requirements.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Operations, Quality Assurance, and Process Science teams to gather system requirements and provide updates on technical activities.
User Training and Enablement: Develop training materials and conduct training sessions to ensure that manufacturing and lab personnel are proficient in using the MES/LES systems effectively in their day-to-day roles.

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

Educational Background: A Bachelor's degree in Engineering (e.g., Industrial, Chemical, Manufacturing, Computer Science) or a related technical field or equivalent experience.
Required Experience: 3+ years hands-on experience with the configuration, and support of an MES platform (e.g., Tulip, Werum PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, POMSnet).
Manufacturing Environment Experience: Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biologics, animal health, or another GxP-regulated industry.
Regulatory Knowledge: A working knowledge of GxP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and familiarity with computer system validation (CSV) principles.
Process Control Understanding: Familiarity with industrial automation concepts, including PLCs, SCADA, and how they integrate with higher-level manufacturing systems.
Database and SQL Skills: Experience with SQL for data queries to support troubleshooting, data extraction, and report generation.

What Will Give You the Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to systematically diagnose and resolve technical issues.
Process Analysis: A solid understanding of business process analysis and workflow design. Ability to read and interpret process maps and requirements documents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment with operators, scientists, and management.
Cloud Platform Proficiency: Familiarity with Public Cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is a plus.
DevSecOps: Familiarity with the concepts of DevSecOps, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and source control (Git), is desirable.
Communication Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a technical team.

Additional Information:

Travel: 0-10%
Location: Hook, UK - Hybrid Work Environment or Speke, UK – Hybrid Work Environment

We are seeking an Principal Solution Architect to lead the evolution of Autodesk Consulting’s Intellectual Property platform as an enterprise-ready SaaS product powered by knowledge architecture, AI-enabled capabilities, and future agentic applications.

new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD96547

Senior Principal Software Engineer (Backend/Full Stack)

Location:
Krakow, Poland (Hybrid)

Position Overview

Autodesk is expanding its engineering presence in Krakow and is looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer
(Backend/Full Stack) to help shape the future of our Smart Factory and Facility Operations platforms. While the target solutions are focused on Go (Golang) and React/JavaScript/TypeScript, we are open to candidates with experience in other technology stacks as well.

You will work across teams and disciplines to build our next-generation cloud web application platform – Tandem – that connects data and workflows across Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT (IIoT), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Digital Twin solutions.

This is a high-impact technical leadership (tech lead) role focused on driving platform strategy and architecture (partnering with experienced Autodesk senior architects) and delivering scalable cloud-native services that support mission-critical customer workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to influence technical direction, solve complex software engineering challenges, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with design and development.

Join us in building software for people who design and make the world around us. From advanced manufacturing, sustainable buildings and resilient infrastructure to media experiences, Autodesk empowers innovators to solve complex challenges through technology.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end delivery of major web application initiatives, from technical strategy and system design through implementation and operational excellence.
Design and build scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native services that support high-volume production workloads – with a focus on backend services while contributing to frontend development when needed.
Partner with Autodesk Architects and Engineering Leaders to define and drive the technical vision and architecture for critical platform services.
Contribute hands-on to software development across full-stack technologies with a focus on Go/C++ backends and React frontends (flexibly adapting to other technologies where appropriate)
Establish engineering standards, architectural patterns, and best practices that improve platform quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering leaders to align technical investments with business objectives.
Guide teams through complex technical challenges, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery goals.
Lead design reviews, provide technical mentorship, and elevate engineering excellence across multiple teams.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Champion operational excellence through observability, automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement practices.
Participate in Agile planning and execution activities while helping teams continuously improve delivery practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale commercial software systems.
Strong experience designing distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native web applications and APIs
Proven experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex software platform initiatives spanning multiple teams
Deep expertise in software engineering, with strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Go (Golang), C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, C#, Python, Java or similar (experience with Go and C++ is particularly valued)
Experience with any modern cloud platform such as AWS (preferred) or Azure.
Strong understanding of data architecture and database technologies.
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery practices.
Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with industrial and manufacturing domains (design, simulation, digital twin, operations), Smart Factory/Industry 4.0 solutions, Industrial IoT (IIoT), facility operations, asset management, AEC etc.
Experience with WebGL, 3D visualization technologies and micro-frontends.
Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and cloud observability practices.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

new_jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

The GBS Capability Optimisation and Automation (GCOA)
organisation is a strategic function focused on transforming finance operations through intelligent automation and AI. GCOA acts as a centralised capability hub, enabling scalable, secure, and compliant solutions that deliver measurable business value.  

GCOA partners with finance and technology teams to:   

Identify automation opportunities.  
Design innovative solutions.  
Embed automation as a core enabler of operational excellence and digital transformation.  

Position Description

The Automation engineer role (P1-P3) will design and build end-to-end automation solutions for Lilly’s global Finance organization working across our full stack platform. The solutions will primarily be built on a platform consisting of a next.js React frontend with Python and PostgresSQL backend hosted on AWS that will interact with Lilly’s AI Platform (NLM and OCR use cases), Microsoft Fabric (PySpark, Delta Lake), SAP API, Graph API and additional systems APIs where necessary.

The primary objective of the team is to develop and deliver automation solutions and other emerging technology solutions for the Finance organization globally. 

This is a fixed term role, ending November 30
th
, 2027.

Responsibilities

Partner with analyst team to review business opportunities and assessing solution feasibility.

new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101130

Help Shape How Cities Are Designed

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us in developing the next generation of our AI-powered architecture design platform. Your contributions will have a direct impact on the quality and capability of our product. You'll work on systems that combine cloud architecture, performance-sensitive applications, and AI to support complex design and simulation workflows.

Your work will enable architects, planners, and developers to discover smarter, more sustainable solutions and gain meaningful insights into their projects.

About Us

We’re on a mission to help design better cities.

With 90% of future population growth expected in urban areas, and construction responsible for around 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. Our cloud-based Autodesk Forma platform helps users evaluate design choices based on environmental impact, living quality (sun, daylight, noise), and project feasibility. We started as Spacemaker in Norway and became part of Autodesk in 2020.

Learn more about Autodesk Forma here.

How We Work

We work in small, autonomous teams with a high degree of trust and ownership. We strongly believe in servant leadership and team accountability. In each team, software engineers work closely together with product managers and designers. To learn more about our way of working, read through our tech and product core beliefs.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will deliver high-quality work and contribute to technical decisions within your team, while increasing your impact through ownership of complex features and systems.

In This Role, You Will

Contribute to technical direction within your team and provide input on architectural decisions
Take ownership of complex features and systems, driving their design and delivery end-to-end
Contribute to technical planning within your team and help align work with product goals
Navigate trade-offs between performance, cost, and user experience in complex workflows
Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver meaningful user outcomes
Share knowledge and support the growth of your teammates

Desired profile

Works independently on complex problems and navigates ambiguity within your domain
Takes ownership of technical decisions within your team and contributes to broader architectural conversations
Strong expertise in your primary domain with growing breadth across related technologies
Collaborates effectively and helps teammates grow
Proactively identifies and acts on improvements within your scope
Collaborates across functions to align engineering with product and user outcomes
Motivated by our mission and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes at scale

Areas of expertise that might resonate with you

You get your energy from building the foundations other people rely on, pulling systems apart into simple, observable pieces, owning something in production long enough to feel responsible for it, and reaching for the boring, reliable option before building something new.
You're drawn to problems where the math is the hard part, geometry, simulation, optimization, and you like taking a model from "this is the theory" to something that runs reliably on real inputs and matches what users expect to see.
You start from the user and the problem, not the ticket. You are comfortable with a fuzzy brief and a blank repo, shipping fast to learn, and shaping what gets built as much as how it gets built.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Strong hands-on engineering background building cloud-based, user-facing systems
Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines and seniority levels
Experience with Agentic AI

You might also bring

Experience with TypeScript, serverless architectures and AWS
Background in large-scale systems or platform development
Experience working in cross-functional, international product teams
Experience with 3D graphics, WebGL/WebGPU, or real-time rendering in the browser
Experience with computational geometry, spatial algorithms, or CAD/BIM data models

Why join us

Work on real-world problems with measurable environmental impact
Shape technical direction at a platform level
Collaborate with experienced engineers across disciplines
Competitive compensation, pension, and benefits

We believe diverse teams build better products, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people can be themselves and do their best work. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement listed. Curiosity, empathy, and a growth mindset matter just as much to us.

Join Autodesk in Oslo as a Software Engineering Intern in Summer 2027

At Autodesk Oslo, we develop next-generation, AI-powered architecture design tools. Our teams build everything from advanced 3D web drawing to real-time analytics powering multiple Autodesk products. About Us

We're on a mission to help design better cities. With 90% of future population growth expected in cities and construction responsible for 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. We're building a new generation of cloud-based software that helps architects, urban planners, and real estate developers design sites and buildings in a new way.

Our Forma Design applications focus on outcome-based design, helping users weigh living quality (sun, daylight potential, noise, etc.), environmental impact (embodied and operational carbon), and profitability so they can find smarter, more sustainable solutions for their projects.

How we work

We work in small, autonomous teams that own their work and decide how best to build it. Engineers, product managers, and designers work side by side, collaborating across functions and time zones. We're an agentic-first organization, so working alongside AI tooling is part of how every team operates.

What you'll do

Over the summer, you'll work on a project that matters to your team, supported by experienced engineers. Your work is meant to ship and reach customers.

As a Software Engineering Intern, You'll

Contribute code to our in-market product, used by architects, urban planners, and real estate developers worldwide

Own a meaningful project from idea through to a working result, with guidance from your team

Gain hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies, from web-based 3D frameworks to large-scale systems and cloud computing

Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve customer problems
Take part in code reviews, design discussions, and the day-to-day work of an engineering team

We invest in your growth from day one. You'll work alongside engineers, designers, and product managers, building your skills in a supportive environment. You'll also work directly with AI-powered tools as part of how we build software.

Beyond your project, you'll be part of the wider team, joining meetups, workshops, and hackathons, and getting a genuine feel for what a career in engineering at Autodesk looks like.

Who should apply

This internship is for students who want to spend their summer building software with a supportive team.

Currently studying computer science, software engineering, or a related field (preferred), ideally in your penultimate year, though we welcome strong students earlier in their studies too

Solid coding fundamentals from coursework, projects, or earlier internships
Curious, collaborative, and comfortable taking initiative and working independently
Comfortable breaking down problems and delivering practical solutions
Motivated by our mission to design better, more sustainable cities
Eligible to work in Norway

Practical details:
Paid internship

Full-time over summer 2027
On-site in our Oslo office
Applications close end of September 2026

We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For us to review your application, you must upload your CV, relevant diplomas/certificates, and academic transcripts in PDF format.

At Autodesk Oslo, we develop next-generation, AI-powered architecture design tools. Our teams build everything from advanced 3D web drawing to real-time analytics powering multiple Autodesk products. As a summer intern, you'll build software that helps shape the Forma Industry Cloud for the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.

About Us

We're on a mission to help design better cities. With 90% of future population growth expected in cities and construction responsible for 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. We're building a new generation of cloud-based software that helps architects, urban planners, and real estate developers design sites and buildings in a new way.

Our Forma Design applications focus on outcome-based design, helping users weigh living quality (sun, daylight potential, noise, etc.), environmental impact (embodied and operational carbon), and profitability so they can find smarter, more sustainable solutions for their projects.

How we work

We work in small, autonomous teams that own their work and decide how best to build it. Engineers, product managers, and designers work side by side, collaborating across functions and time zones. We're an agentic-first organization, so working alongside AI tooling is part of how every team operates.

What you'll do

Over the summer, you'll work on a project that matters to your team, supported by experienced engineers. Your work is meant to ship and reach customers.

Contribute code to our in-market product, used by architects, urban planners, and real estate developers worldwide

Own a meaningful project from idea through to a working result, with guidance from your team

Gain hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies, from web-based 3D frameworks to large-scale systems and cloud computing

new_jobs.title: Value Architect, Industry 4.0
new_jobs.description:
A senior industrial data and IT/OT expert who turns operational data into results, advising our key clients from strategy through delivery.

Do you enjoy working with industrial data and AI, where OT meets IT and data becomes operational results? Are you equally at home advising senior client stakeholders with a strategic vision and roadmap and, as lead architect, staying hands-on through the work that delivers it? If your answer is yes, then we are looking for you, Value Architect, to join our growing Data & AI Studio.

At Nortal, we build solutions and services that bring real value to users and society as a whole. In Finland, we have nearly 200 employees, and internationally we operate in over 20 countries. Our Data & AI Studio brings together strategy, engineering, and AI to help industrial enterprises turn operational data into results, bridging OT and IT from the shop floor to the cloud, and moving from discovery to scalable, production-grade solutions.

As a Value Architect, Industry 4.0 in our Data & AI Studio, you are a senior subject-matter expert and the trusted advisor industrial clients lean on to turn operational data into results. This is primarily a client-facing role. You work with senior stakeholders on where unified industrial data and AI turn cost into advantage, which investments return the most in uptime, quality, and decision speed, and which team should deliver them. You own the architecture across the IT and OT boundary and stay hands-on through delivery. A smaller part of the role helps the practice grow: you support presales when your expertise is needed, feed what you learn back into our industrial offering, and now and then share it through talks and writing. One morning you frame the business case with a VP of operations. That afternoon you review an edge-to-cloud architecture with the engineers who will build it.

The offering you will work with

Our work in this space turns industrial data into operational results. Most industrial enterprises want to scale AI but cannot, because fragmented OT and IT systems and inconsistent data quality leave them without a foundation to build on. We fix that first.

You take the lead on engagements like our Industrial Data & AI Kickstart and the platform and use-case work that grows out of it. You own them as the lead architect: facilitating the workshops, conducting a significant share of the analysis and design yourself, and bringing in specific experts, from IT/OT and cloud to integration and data and AI, where deeper specialism is needed.
This is operations-first work. It runs from the shop floor to the cloud, bridges OT and IT, and is grounded in real operational needs rather than slideware. You start here, sharpen the offering as you run it, and help shape what comes next.

What You Will Do

This is primarily a client-facing role.

Advise clients and protect the value
Be the trusted advisor.
Work with senior client stakeholders (heads of operations and manufacturing, plant and maintenance leaders, CDOs and CIOs) to connect their priorities to data and AI outcomes, and shape strategies and roadmaps they can act on.
Run the Kickstart.
Lead the discovery and design workshops, assess the as-is OT and IT landscape, and produce the edge-to-cloud target architecture, the governance and operating model, and the roadmap the client executes against.
Own the architecture.
Steer architecture and design decisions across the IT and OT boundary so solutions scale and stay governed, secure, and compliant. You need not ship every integration yourself, but you stand behind the design.
Stay through delivery.
Don’t hand off after the Kickstart. Stay hands-on through platform foundation and use-case pilots to protect the architecture, data governance, quality, and the value case into production.

Contribute to the offering and the practice
A smaller part of the role looks inward. You support presales when your expertise is needed, handle the hard technical objections, and help shape proposals and value cases. You turn what you learn on engagements into reusable patterns and proof points, and you share some of it through talks and writing. You mentor others and help run AI-aware delivery teams, so the practice grows beyond any one person.

What We Hope You Bring

A senior background in manufacturing operations management and industrial data with business acumen
(IT/OT or IIoT Architect, Industrial Data Architect, MES/MOM Lead, or similar), with ten or more years on the consulting or customer side.
Domain depth.
Working knowledge of more than one industry or industry type we serve is required, so you can speak the customer’s language from day one. Experience in both process and discrete industries, such as metals, forest, energy, packaging, chemical, or machine building, is especially welcome.
A track record of growing trusted client relationships
and turning advice into delivered work, with real ownership of the outcome rather than the handover.
Consultative mindset
. You lead with the customer’s operational problem, not with technology. You listen, frame the real question, and guide senior stakeholders to a decision they own. Enterprise architecture skills and experience are a strong asset here, connecting business strategy, operating model, data, and technology into one coherent picture.
Industrial platform familiarity
. Comfortable across the industrial stack, from shop floor to cloud: IT/OT integration, MES/MOM, process historians, edge and connectivity tooling, OPC UA and UNS architectures, data analytics over time-series data, and standards such as ISA-95/88. You are familiar with OT infrastructure, networking, and security, and with architecting containerized workloads at the edge. On the cloud side, you are comfortable with modern data stacks such as Azure IoT, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks. Relevant certifications are a plus.
Applied AI.
Experience with machine learning solutions deployed in production (beyond PoC scope) for areas such as production, maintenance, quality, and warehouse optimization. GenAI solutions in production are a plus.
Communication.
Strong spoken, written, and presentation skills in Finnish and English, with the ability to reach shop floor engineers, enterprise architects, and operations leaders. German is an asset.
AI-first ways of working.
Comfortable using modern AI tools in your own work, with coding agents a plus. You work AI-first by habit, not by exception.

Why join us

Work where data meets the shop floor.
Real plants and real operations, from the Kickstart through to production, not perpetual pilots. You see the architecture you stand behind actually run.
A community, not a silo.
A multidisciplinary network behind you, from IT/OT, cloud, and integration architects to data and AI specialists, and delivery teams who can actually ship what you design.
Sell from strength.
Twenty-five years of industrial delivery, with experience in industrial digitalization dating back to 1987 and long-standing work with metals, energy, and forest clients. We are a Featured Microsoft Fabric Partner and one of the very few partners named in Microsoft’s Industrial AI Partner Guide.

Salary range:
5900-8800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Vitol is a leader in energy and commodities. Vitol produces, manages and delivers energy and commodities, including metals, to consumers and industry worldwide. In addition to its primary business, trading, Vitol is invested in infrastructure globally, with $13+billion invested in long-term assets.

Vitol’s customers include national oil companies, multinationals, leading industrial companies and utilities. Founded in Rotterdam in 1966, today Vitol serves its customers from some 40 offices worldwide. Revenues in 2024 were over $330bn.

Find out more at vitol.com.

Job Description

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our Singapore-based analytics team. You will work closely with commercial and operational desks globally, building innovative applications that directly influence the firm's decisions.

You will play a key role in transforming our existing application landscape — rapidly prototyping, iterating, and delivering scalable solutions. You'll need to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, manage project lifecycles independently, and thrive in a fast-paced trading environment.

Our stack is C# and/or Python on the backend, with React (TypeScript) on the frontend.
Strong candidates will be proficient in at least one backend language alongside React; familiarity with both C# and Python is a significant advantage.

Responsibilities

Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to design and implement scalable, high-quality systems with a high degree of autonomy
Identify requirements and develop solutions that directly influence commercial decisions
Manage project lifecycles end-to-end, from requirements gathering through to delivery
Write and maintain data feeds critical to analytics platforms and pricing models
Develop a deep understanding of Vitol's MIS platforms to help them evolve and thrive

Qualifications

Required:

Relevant university degree

Job Requisition ID #

26WD96668

Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer – Fusion Operations

Location: Portugal (Hybrid/Remote options available)

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
to join our Fusion Operations
team in Portugal.

Fusion Operations is a cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that provides real-time visibility into production processes—from raw materials to final delivery. It enables manufacturers to optimize scheduling, track inventory, monitor operations, and ensure product quality and compliance.

We’re looking for an engineer who is passionate about building scalable, real-world solutions and has strong experience across the full web application stack. You will play a key role in designing and delivering reliable, high-impact features used by customers globally.

What You’ll Do

Lead the design, development, testing, and maintenance of real-time, business-critical applications
Build clean, secure, scalable, and maintainable full-stack solutions
Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality features
Review code, provide constructive feedback, and drive engineering best practices
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues using effective debugging techniques
Develop and maintain automated tests to improve code quality and coverage
Leverage AWS services (e.g., S3, SQS, RDS) to build scalable cloud solutions
Contribute to system reliability and performance through monitoring and improvements
Mentor junior engineers and support their technical growth
Participate in an on-call rotation to support production systems

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
+5 years of experience building and delivering scalable web applications
Strong proficiency in Java and solid understanding of its ecosystem
Experience with frontend technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
Understanding of RESTful APIs and MVC architecture
Experience with MySQL or other relational databases
Hands-on experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms
Experience with Docker and containerized environments
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)
Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability in dynamic environments
Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a relevant field
Experience with Java frameworks such as Spring or Play
Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue.js)
Experience with Elasticsearch or similar search technologies
Experience with test automation tools (JUnit, Selenium, etc.)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins)
Knowledge of build tools (Maven, Gradle, Ant)
Understanding of event-driven architectures

Why Join Fusion Operations?

Work on a product that directly impacts manufacturing efficiency worldwide
Build solutions that solve real, complex industry problems
Collaborate with a global, highly skilled engineering team
Contribute to a modern cloud platform with real-time capabilities

About Autodesk

Autodesk makes software for people who design and make the world. From sustainable buildings and advanced manufacturing to media and entertainment, our solutions empower innovators to turn ideas into reality.

We foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and belonging—where you can do meaningful work and grow your career.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.
